A curved blade of considerable size whose keen edge is only made more deadly by its imposing weight.

This curved greatsword demands both strength and dexterity of its wielder, rewarding those capable of mastering it with great, sweeping slashes that mow through multiple foes at once.

RW-ITEM-dismounter.text:
This curved greatsword wielded by the brawny sellswords of Kaiden combines the blades of a scimitar with the heft of a hatchet.

A difficult to handle weapon that demands much of the wielder's strength and dexterity, but with practice and ability, it can serve as a versatile weapon even on horseback.

RW-ITEM-omen-cleaver.text:
Heavy-bladed curved sword of colossal size awarded to Omen as a tool of war. This weapon is made to take advantage of brute strength.

The pattern etched upon the blade is the remnant of a deteriorative malediction. Indeed, when bestowing a weapon, preparations must be made for taking it away.

RW-ITEM-monk-s-flameblade.text:
Curved sword with a flickering flame motif. Wielded by the Fire Monks who came out from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The monks came to the land of Liurnia in pursuit of a fugitive who stole their fire.

RW-ITEM-beastman-s-cleaver.text:
Curved greatsword of colossal size forged of dull iron and wielded by the beastmen of Farum Azula.

The blade is incredibly heavy, but well-balanced. Comparatively easy to wield for the damage it delivers. It's clear the beastmen possess knowledge beyond human ken.

TP-COL-REVERSE-BLADED-SWORD.text:
Curved blade wielded with a backhand grip, said to have originated from the hidden realm of shadow.

The style of combat associated with this weapon is marked by spinning slashes and gouging thrust attacks.

RW-ITEM-curseblade-s-cirque.text:
Weapon of the masked Curseblades. Circular backhand blade with wave-like cutting edges, sharpened into points that incite blood loss.

Long ago, this was employed by the ascetics who strove to become tutelary deities as a ritualistic object in their self-flagellating dances.

TP-COL-REED-GREAT-KATANA.text:
Large katana with a long, heavy blade.
A weapon unique to warriors of the Land of Reeds.

Designed for aggression, this armament requires the wielder to throw their entire body into swinging it. The slashing attacks of its honed edge incite blood loss.

RW-ITEM-forked-hatchet.text:
Peculiar hatched wielded by imps.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

RW-ITEM-forked-tongue-hatchet.text:
A peculiar weapon wielded by imps. Hatchet smithed in the shape of a fork-tongued dragon.

The gently undulating forked blade is known as an "imp's tongue" and causes blood loss.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-s-axe.text:
Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A steel axe, worn from use.

A favorite of those who lost themselves utterly in their lord's war. Capable of performing powerful charge attacks.

RW-ITEM-warped-axe.text:
Oversized double-headed axe with a bizarre, almost melted appearance.

Brute strength is the only thing required to wield this weapon, which appears to have taken quite the beating itself.

RW-ITEM-jawbone-axe.text:
Axe made from a herbivore's skull. Weapon of the ancestral followers who disdain metal.

This axe is more of a bludgeon; it forgoes a bladed edge, instead using the beast's molar teeth to buffet foes, dealing strike damage.

RW-ITEM-iron-cleaver.text:
Fairly large iron cleaver, commonly used by the maltreated Misbegotten.

Steeped in resentment, these weapons are swung wildly and relentlessly, often after rushing up to foes.

RW-ITEM-celebrant-s-cleaver.text:
Cleaver decorated with many-colored fabrics.
Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Crafted from human bone.
Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

RW-ITEM-crescent-moon-axe.text:
Greataxe with a large, arcing blade and long handle. The "Crescent Moon" of its name is said to have been spurred by nostalgia.

Specializes in sweeping through foes by making use of its long handle.

RW-ITEM-longhaft-axe.text:
Large iron axe with a long handle. Weapon of the maltreated Misbegotten.

Making use of the force generated by its length, this weapon's resentment-charged blows are difficult to stop.

RW-ITEM-executioner-s-greataxe.text:
Bulky cleaver welded to a long shaft. Said to have been used to dispatch the remnants of defeated enemies, felling them like timber.

Perhaps that is the reason it excels at critical hits.

RW-ITEM-curved-club.text:
Hard, curved club, shaped like a crescent moon.

Wielded instead of a curved sword by Albinaurics lacking dexterity. The only point of similarity between the two is the shape.

RW-ITEM-spiked-club.text:
A club with beast fangs wrapped around the striking end. The uneven spread of fangs causes blood loss.

Given only to the toughest of demi-humans, this weapon is a badge of honor. Or so the demi-humans believe.

RW-ITEM-stone-club.text:
Signature weapon of battlemages, hewn from hard glintstone. This club is much heavier than its size suggest, but has no magic power.

So that they not lose sight of the true essence of combat, battlemages prefer to feel the impact of their blows, fighting their opponents hand to hand.

RW-ITEM-warpick.text:
Great hammer with a hard protruding beak. A pickaxe designed for combat, in essence.

A simple but highly effective weapon, the weighty piercing attack casually rips through metal armor.

RW-ITEM-monk-s-flamemace.text:
Great hammer made to resemble flickering flames. Signature weapon of the Fire Monks, who hail from the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The unique strong attack rouses fiery combative spirit.

RW-ITEM-envoy-s-horn.text:
Golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

RW-ITEM-chainlink-flail.text:
A spiked iron tube attached by a chain wielded by Mad Pumpkin Heads.

Especially large for a flail, wielding it requires more strength than it does dexterity.

TP-COL-GOLDEN-ORDER-FLAIL.text:
A flail with three golden rings for striking heads, the sacred signature weapon of the esteemed Broken Mask.

The golden bands are modelled upon the Elden Ring itself, half-corporeal and half formed of light, all in the process of shattering.

RW-ITEM-pickaxe.text:
Large pickaxe designed to crack thick bedrock. Tool of sturdy miners.

Not originally designed as a weapon, but very adept of piercing armor. "Little wretches, do you think your armor harder than stone?"

RW-ITEM-battle-hammer.text:
Large iron great hammer designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

Weighty enough to crush armor and its wearer alike.

RW-ITEM-celebrant-s-skull.text:
Large bludgeon decorated with flowers and many-decorated fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

The striking end is a skull too large in size to be human. Grants trace amount of runes on landing attacks.

RW-ITEM-greathorn-hammer.text:
Huge thick horn carved with tree ring-like markings adapted into a bludgeoning weapon. Wielded by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancient horn is imbued with the power of ancestral spirits. A small amount of HP is restored upon defeating an enemy.

RW-ITEM-envoy-s-long-horn.text:
Long golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps is it too early to sound the call.

Unique Skill : Bubble Shower

Blow on the horn to release a spume of magic bubbles. The bubbles float gently before raining down the target.

RW-ITEM-duelist-greataxe.text:
Greataxe designed for gladiatorial combat. Used by duelists who were exiled from the colosseum.

A weapon reserved for duelist champions, the charge attack is particularly ferocious.

RW-ITEM-golem-s-halberd.text: A great halberd of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Wielded by the Guardian Golem.

RW-ITEM-bloodfiend-s-arm.text:
Weapon used by the bloodfiends. An arm pulled from the corpse of one of their kin, and wielded as a makeshift weapon.

Having been sanctified by a blood ritual, this armament is capable of spraying blood stored within when executing a strong attack.

RW-ITEM-envoy-s-greathorn.text:
Fanned golden horn of the Oracle Envoys. Profoundly weighty, its blows are sure to be felt.

Originally an instrument, but one that cannot be sounded by a mere human. Or perhaps it is too early to sound the call.

Unique Skill : Great Oracular Bubble

Blow on the horn to release a massive magic bubble. The bubble floats gently through the air towards its target.

RW-ITEM-iron-spear.text: Commonly used iron spear with no notable traits. The blade is severely rusted.

RW-ITEM-spear.text:
Weapon comprised of a blade attached to a long shaft.

A far-reaching piercing weapon, it can be wielded from behind the safety of a raised shield. Very effective against mounted foes.

RW-ITEM-partisan.text:
Spear with a wide tip.

In addition to its thrusting attacks, this highly versatile weapon can be swung to sweep through foes.

RW-ITEM-spiked-spear.text:
Weapon comprised of a spiked cylinder attached to a long pole. Capable of dealing strike damage when swung. The spikes induce blood loss.

Weapon of the Marionette Soldiers employed by sorcerers.

RW-ITEM-clayman-s-harpoon.text:
Harpoon with a tip made from a sharpened meteorite shard. Wielded by the claymen who infest dynastic remains.

The blade emits a faint light and deals magic damage.

RW-ITEM-bloodfiend-s-fork.text:
Weapon used by the bloodfiends. Three tines of carved bone spear the victim to provoke blood loss.

A ritual implement for blood offerings to the Formless Mother. At times, the bloodfiends will spill even their own blood using these forks.

RW-ITEM-celebrant-s-rib-rake.text:
Rake decorated with many-colored fabrics. Ceremonial tool used by dancers during the festivities of Dominula, Windmill Village.

Crafted from human bone. Grants trace amounts of runes upon landing attacks.

RW-ITEM-torchpole.text:
Torch fastened to a long pole. Lights up dark areas, but cannot be raised overhead.

Used by soldiers on watch, its attacks set foes aflame.

RW-ITEM-rotten-crystal-spear.text:
Spear fashioned from pure crystal; a deed impossible for a human. It festers with scarlet rot.

Enwreathed with powerful magic, its attack scales with intelligence.

RW-ITEM-cleanrot-spear.text:
Spear of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

The winged golden blade deals holy damage. The diminutive shield is blessed with an incantation that wards off rot.

Unique Skill: Sacred Phalanx

Release the power of a hidden incantation to erect a palisade of golden spears frontwards.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-s-spear.text:
Weapon used by the soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A greatspear with a steel blade worn from use.

Being made for overwhelming onslaughts, attacks with this weapon can be charged to unleash consecutive strikes.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-s-halberd.text:
A finely-crafted halberd intricately engraved with an ancient motif. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

RW-ITEM-glaive.text:
Weapon comprised of a sharp blade affixed to a long grip. It is in fact a sickle repurposed to be a tool of war.

This far-reaching weapon excels at slashing attacks.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-shotel.text:
A hooked blade attached to a long handle. Wielded by the vulgar militia, its attacks can slip through an enemy's guard.

The vulgar militia are undecorated stewards of rancid, scorched battlefields that none dare approach, and forbidden domains better forgotten by the rest of the world.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-saw.text:
A weapon comprised of a saw blade attached to a long grip. Brandished by the vulgar militia, its serrated edge is very effective at inflicting blood loss.

The saw is said to also be used to cut up bodies to feed the militia, but there are no firsthand witnesses to confirm the dire rumor.

RW-ITEM-guardian-s-swordspear.text:
Weapon comprising a long handle and broad blade sharpened from the hard wood of old trees.

Wielded by guardians of the Minor Erdtrees, known as experts in the arts of combat. The power of this weapon scales greatly with dexterity.

RW-ITEM-pest-s-glaive.text:
Glaive made from a hard, sharpened shell. Wielded by the pests who emerged from the Swamp of Aeonia. Slightly increases non-physical damage negation.

Though men might recognize the keen intellect of the pests evidenced by this spear's uncanny design, it will never be understood by them.

RW-ITEM-ripple-crescent-halberd.text:
Weapon wielded by young Albinaurics.

The blade is said to resemble a partial image of a ripple, and its attack power scales with one's arcane attribute.

RW-ITEM-grave-scythe.text:
Greatscythe comprised of a large blade affixed to a crooked stick. Weapon wielded by the aged grave keepers who tend the forgotten graveyards throughout the Lands Between.

This weapon is said to have served as a charm against evil spirits in times of old.

RW-ITEM-halo-scythe.text:
War scythe of the Cleanrot Knights who fought alongside Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

This was the weapon of commanders in Malenia's army, and the half-halo blade deals holy damage.

Unique Skill: Miquella's Ring of Light

Summon Miquella's shining halo and fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.

RW-ITEM-thorned-whip.text:
Hefty whip covered in crimson thorns. Weapon of the Prelates who lead the Fire Monks. A device of fearsome religious encouragement, it is fashioned in the image of the briars of sin.

Very effective at inflicting blood loss.

RW-ITEM-golem-fist.text:
A giant fist of fractured rock. Taken from the body of a golem of the ruined forges.

Carved with a smithscript enabling strong attacks to launch the entire fist straight ahead.

RW-ITEM-misbegotten-shortbow.text:
Shortbow wielded by Winged Misbegotten. Fine fur clings to it.

Designed to inflict additional damage by sacrificing range.

RW-ITEM-albinauric-bow.text:
Longbow featuring delicate silverwork. Wielded by Albinauric wolfback archers.

This bow requires dexterity over strength to master.

RW-ITEM-greatbow.text:
Enormous greatbow larger than any man. Can not be drawn with any ordinary level of strength, but the force of its shots is extraordinary.

A greatbow can only fire great arrows.

RW-ITEM-golem-greatbow.text:
Greatbow of black stone crafted by a civilization now gone to ruin. Weapon of the Guardian Golem.

Extremely heavy, this greatbow requires enormous strength just to draw, suggesting it was not designed for human use.

RW-ITEM-soldier-s-crossbow.text:
A crossbow of simple make, usable by anyone, but lacking in both power and accuracy.

Bolts must be equipped to use a crossbow.

RW-ITEM-heavy-crossbow.text:
Heavy crossbow with iron limbs, increasing damage dealt.

Commonly employed in the Shattering.

RW-ITEM-rickety-shield.text:
A creaky old wooden shield, circular in shape. Roughly reinforced with vines.

There are countless other shields available of better make. This piece of scrap isn't worth the effort of equipping.

RW-ITEM-scripture-wooden-shield.text:
A small, wooden roundshield. It is light and easy to handle, but cannot offer the damage negation of a metal shield.

An ancient cipher engraving lines the circumference. Though it isn't much, it boosts holy damage negation.

RW-ITEM-man-serpent-s-shield.text:
Small copper dome-shaped roundshield carried by the man-serpents of Mt. Gelmir.

Said to have been tempered in lava, it boasts great resistance to fire.

RW-ITEM-perfumer-s-shield.text:
Golden shield used by the perfumers of Leyndell during military service.

Made to be thin and light of weight, even those lacking strength can employ this immunity-boosting shield.

RW-ITEM-sun-realm-shield.text:
Shield of honor depicting a city crowned by the sun. It has seen better days.

Much like the wear upon the shield, the Seat of the Sun is long faded away.

TP-COL-SILVER-GROOVED-SHIELD.text:
A silver shield whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight.

The elegant grooves render a picturesque scene, recalling the faraway Erdtree's principles.

Spread out above shall its many boughs, spread below shall its many roots, till the whole world knows its blessing.

RW-ITEM-inverted-hawk-heater-shield.text:
A medium-sized metal shield. Easier to handle than a kite shield.

The inverted hawk is the emblem of the company of slaves ordered to explore the Eternal City.

RW-ITEM-brass-shield.text:
On the larger side for medium-sized shield, the face has been covered in brass.

Commonly employed in the Shattering.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-s-shield.text:
A tall medium-sized metal shield. Given to knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Most of these knights were sent to the fringes, where they were forced to start anew with only despair for company.

RW-ITEM-albinauric-shield.text:
Tall oval shield made of metal carried by young Albinaurics.

The ornamentation represents the primordial drop of dew from which they are said to have been created. Boasts exceptional magic damage negation. The Albinaurics' most formidable foes were sorcerers, after all.

RW-ITEM-beastman-s-jar-shield.text:
Shield fashioned from a tall broken jar carried by the beastmen of Farum Azula. There is a particular knack to wielding it.

The beastmen have always fired earthenware jars for the express purpose of making shields. Such are their ways, strange though they are.

RW-ITEM-lordsworn-s-shield.text:
Wooden tower shield. Lightweight for a greatshield and easy to handle. Commonly used in the Shattering.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

RW-ITEM-inverted-hawk-towershield.text:
An iron greatshield large enough to cover the entire body. Features an inverted hawk crest.

Greatshields boast high damage negation and guard capacity, making enemy attacks easy to repel.

RW-ITEM-gilded-greatshield.text:
Metal greatshield coated with gold. Carried by knights loyal to Godrick.

The red tinge in the gold coat mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree. The color of homeward yearning.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-greatshield.text:
Metal greatshield painted with a peering cuckoo. Carried by the enchanted knights sworn to the academy.

Boasting high magic damage negation, this shield is used to hunt down mages. "Our enemy is none other than Caria itself."

RW-ITEM-redmane-greatshield.text:
Greatshield shaped like a fang, featuring the crest of red-maned lion.

Carried by the Redmane Knights who fought alongside Radahn.

RW-ITEM-golden-greatshield.text:
Oval greatshield made of gold, carried by knights who protect the Royal Capital of Leyndell.

Knights of Leyndell are reputed for their sturdiness, exemplified by this shield's exceptional guard capacity.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-crest-greatshield.text:
Metal greatshield depicting the Haligtree with unalloyed gold. Carried by knights who have vowed to serve Miquella's Haligtree. Possesses high holy damage negation.

Yet now, with the Haligtree misshapen, this wondrous rendition is a fleeting fantasy.

RW-ITEM-eclipse-crest-greatshield.text:
Metal greatshield painted with a sun in eclipse. Carried by the headless mausoleum knights.

The eclipsed sun, drained of color, is the protective star of soulless demigods. It aids the mausoleum knights by keeping Destined Death at bay.

TP-COL-RITUAL-THRUSTING-SHIELD.text:
A "thrusting shield," or combined weapon and shield.
Enables the wielder to attack and guard simultaneously.

An armament once used in rites of combat performed to honor the Erdtree, now lost to time.

RW-ITEM-commoner-s-headband.text:
A headband that holds cloth in place.

Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about
them.

RW-ITEM-commoner-s-headband-altered.text:
A headband with the cloth removed. Standard wear for
commoners of the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about
them.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-headband.text:
Valuable headband featuring fine goldwork. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-hat.text:
Leather hat decorated with a withered feather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belonging of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

RW-ITEM-old-aristocrat-cowl.text:
Cowl made of soft cloth. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.
Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-page-hood.text:
Hood worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen and unknown nature.

RW-ITEM-high-page-hood.text:
Hood of a page selected for special privileges by the noble
they serve.

The unassuming sack-like appearance befits their unseen
and unknown stature.

RW-ITEM-guardian-mask.text:
Engraved golden mask. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

RW-ITEM-festive-hood.text:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village
of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

RW-ITEM-festive-hood-altered.text:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village
of windmills.

Decorated with many-colored flowers.

RW-ITEM-blue-festive-hood.text:
Hood worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this hood, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

RW-ITEM-guilty-hood.text:
Coarse hooded cloak of olive brown.

The garb of those accused of lesser crimes, indicated by
the collar of sharpened branches.

RW-ITEM-black-dumpling.text:
Mask forced on a victim's head to lend torture an extra degree of cruelty. It magnifies one's fears and makes them acutely aware of all forms of pain.

Raises attack power when the wearer suffers from madness.

When the Black Dumpling goes on, the torturer no longer seeks answers; only to inflict suffering without hope of relief.

TP-COL-BROKEN-GOLD-MASK.text:
A mask designed to resemble a blazing golden halo, though a piece is now broken off.

The attire of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Enhances incantations and skills that harness Causality.

Upon the splintering of the Golden Order, so too did these companions part ways. One kept the faith, though the faith itself was broken, while the other fell completely to his own doubts.

RW-ITEM-perfumer-hood.text:
Hood of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

RW-ITEM-depraved-perfumer-headscarf.text:
Headscarf worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to
alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction
is what earned them their name.

RW-ITEM-great-horned-headband.text:
Headband decorated by a pair of great horns. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

RW-ITEM-shining-horned-headband.text:
Headband decorated by a pair of shining horns. Worn by ancestral follower shamans.

Horns with buds that also shine are ideal ceremonial items for ancestral worship. Strengthens Ancestral Infant's Head.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-cat.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a cat, it holds trace amounts of feline intelligence.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-wolf.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a wolf, it holds trace amounts of lupine endurance.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-fanged.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a fanged demon, it holds trace amounts of bestial
strength.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-long-tongued.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling a long-tongued demon, it holds trace amounts of
vexatious dexterity.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-corpse.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling the visage of a corpse, it holds trace amounts of
lingering faith.

RW-ITEM-imp-head-elder.text:
Head covering made from the largely unaltered head of an
impish golem.

Resembling an elder, it holds trace amounts of arcane knowledge.

RW-ITEM-octopus-head.text:
A land octopus whelp worn directly on the head. Has a lingering warmth reminiscent of human skin.

Those who can withstand the smell will find its organic elasticity excellent for negating strikes.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-helm.text:
Wholly unembellished iron helm. Widely issued to foot
soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-helmet.text:
Helmet with a protective metal plate. Widely issued to foot
soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-cap.text: Flanged iron cap widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-gilded-foot-soldier-cap.text:
Flanged cap made from gilded iron. Issued to foot soldiers
protecting the royal capital of Leyndell.

RW-ITEM-sacred-crown-helm.text:
Flanged iron cap adorned with a crown of unalloyed gold. Increases faith.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

Who is that Miquella shall bless, if not the low and the meek?

RW-ITEM-highwayman-hood.text:
Hideously stained and ragged hood. Worn by former foot
soldiers who have turned to banditry.

RW-ITEM-common-soldier-helm.text:
Helm of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-helm.text:
Helm worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

The upward extension serves to create an appearance of larger size, however slightly.

RW-ITEM-shadow-militiaman-helm.text:
Helm as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

RW-ITEM-duelist-helm.text:
Bronze helm decorated with innumerable snakes. Worn by
gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer
becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience
delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

RW-ITEM-nox-monk-hood.text:
Silk hood worn by monks of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-nox-swordstress-crown.text:
Crown worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and the silk hides their eyes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-night-maiden-twin-crown.text:
Twin crowns worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and hides the eyes with silk.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-curseblade-mask.text:
A mask affixed with a crown of tangled horns, worn by those who would invoke divinity.

Divine invocation heightens the dexterity of the wearer, but causes the blessings of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effects of drinking from the flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this mask.

RW-ITEM-godrick-soldier-helm.text:
Helm worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Made from
durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif beneath.

RW-ITEM-raya-lucarian-helm.text: Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Its brow is adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

RW-ITEM-radahn-soldier-helm.text: Helm worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Its visor is fashioned after a lion's fangs.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-soldier-helm.text:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Made from durable iron, layered with a chainmail coif
beneath.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-helm.text:
Helm worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. An iron helm
graced by a crown of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-helm.text:
Helm worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. The iron helm features a visor.

Though the engraving upon the forehead is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

RW-ITEM-exile-hood.text:
Deep red hood that covers the whole head.

Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies, who were
required to keep their faces hidden.

RW-ITEM-kaiden-helm.text:
Helm worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the
mountaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on
horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

TP-COL-LEONTIELS-HAT.text:
A sharp-brimmed ceremonial hat affixed with a mask, the favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel.

Leontiel admired Jerren as a father figure of sorts, and this mask lends her the same distinguished severity she saw in his own.

RW-ITEM-leontiel-s-hat-altered.text:
A sharp-brimmed ceremonial hat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel.

Features a long, pointed crest that juts out from behind.

RW-ITEM-marionette-soldier-helm.text:
Cylindrical helm of plate metal reinforced with a lattice. Worn
by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this helm is remarkably crude.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

RW-ITEM-blue-silver-mail-hood.text:
Chainmail hood crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

RW-ITEM-fire-monk-hood.text:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with
flames. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden
by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of
the Giants.

RW-ITEM-blackflame-monk-hood.text:
Mail hood of iron links covering a headband engraved with flames. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

TP-COL-SILVER-GROOVED-HELM.text:
A silver helm whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear.

In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

RW-ITEM-godrick-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Adorned
with a plume of withered, ashen hair.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Its brow is
adorned with a single cuckoo's feather.

RW-ITEM-redmane-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

The red plume is a symbol of Radahn's pedigree as Lord Radagon's son - the mane of the proud Red Lion.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell.

The golden canopy represents the honor of standing among the
tree's defenders.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Graced by a crown
of unalloyed gold.

Increases faith.

RW-ITEM-black-knight-helm.text:
Helm worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

RW-ITEM-cleanrot-helm.text:
Winged helm of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their
undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite
the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their
acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

RW-ITEM-fire-knight-helm.text:
Pointed helm of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Slightly increases maximum HP, stamina, and maximum equip load.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

RW-ITEM-horned-warrior-helm.text:
Helm featuring a crown of sturdy tangled horns, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Attire of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

Divine invocation bolsters the strength of the wearer, but causes the blessing of the Erdtree to become nauseating, reducing the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

RW-ITEM-divine-beast-helm.text:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine beast mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine beast warriors; the chosen of the horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens intensity of the storm alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

RW-ITEM-divine-bird-helm.text:
A helm of tangled horn attached to a divine bird mask, allowing the wearer to invoke divinity. Worn by divine bird warriors; the very first of all horned warriors.

Divine invocation heightens the power of divine bird feathers alongside strength and dexterity, but reduces the restorative effect of drinking from a flask of sacred tears.

Focus is also troubled by wearing this helm.

TP-COL-STEEL-HELM.text:
A helm of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation.

A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield.

Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-helm.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

Perhaps the deep-red scarf was used to block the winds, for on the outskirts, the winds bite with a stinging fierceness.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-helm-altered.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This helm was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

RW-ITEM-fire-prelate-helm.text:
Helm engraved with a sacred countenance and housing a
cauldron. Attire of the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire
Monks.

It is said the cauldron perched atop the head was originally
furnished with embers, and would surge into flames when
the wearer's faith reached its zenith. The fire of this cauldron
has since died out, however.

RW-ITEM-pumpkin-helm.text:
An oval helm large enough to cover any head. Very heavy and very hard.

Reduces damage from headshots and impacts.

The inside of the helm is pitch black, keeping the crazed warrior within from panicking. Perhaps its rather roomy interior also helps alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

RW-ITEM-commoner-s-garb.text:
Garb with a thick embroidered cape attached. Standard wear for commoners of the Lands Between.

The board hung from the neck depicts a sprawling tree, its roots and branches forming two holes. This is a self-imposed shackle, a voluntary display of allegiance to the Erdtree that increases faith.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-garb.text:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-garb-altered.text:
High quality garb adorned with fine golden embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Terribly faded and tattered.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-coat.text:
Tanned leather coat adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital, and the belongings of a family which claims a knight as an ancestor.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of unending life.

RW-ITEM-old-aristocrat-gown.text:
Gown of soft cloth adorned with fine gold embroidery. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-page-garb.text:
Garb worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

RW-ITEM-high-page-clothes.text:
Clothes of a page selected for special privileges by the noble they serve.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

RW-ITEM-guardian-garb.text:
Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

RW-ITEM-guardian-garb-full-bloom.text:
Engraved golden garb. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

Raises the HP recovery effects of the Flask of Crimson Tears, but greatly lowers fire damage negation.

It is said that the blood-red flowers blooming on their back mark the senescence of their ancient pact. Perhaps the guardians are part tree already.

RW-ITEM-festive-garb.text:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

RW-ITEM-festive-garb-altered.text:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Faintly bloodstained.

RW-ITEM-blue-festive-garb.text:
Ceremonial garb worn by dancers at the festivities in Dominula, the village of windmills.

Use of this garb, dyed in a stunning blue, is only permitted for the young maids who play the central role in the festival.

RW-ITEM-raya-lucarian-robe.text:
Robe worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery.

Those who dedicate themselves to the study of glintstones formed from starry amber receive this modest yet elegant deep navy garb after making their vows of virtue and austerity.

But with extended life, one is apt to forget old vows.

RW-ITEM-lazuli-robe.text:
Robe worn by scholars of the Lazuli Conspectus, singular among the greater Raya Lucaria Academy.

Theses scholars, who sought to master Carian sorcery, instead learned to see the moon as equal to the stars. This robe, in the hue of the full moon, signifies their heresy.

TP-COL-GOLD-TATTOO-CHEST.text:
An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh.

The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus.

It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule.
"Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

RW-ITEM-perfumer-robe.text:
Robe of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

The thick front apron ambroidered with a depiction of the Erdtree is proof of mastery of the apothecarial arts, and its weight symbolizes the onus of both pride and responsibility.

RW-ITEM-depraved-perfumer-robe.text:
Robe worn by depraved perfumers. The embroidery on the apron is itself a curse upon the Erdtree.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

RW-ITEM-fur-raiment.text:
Raiment fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-tabard.text: Padded cloth armor with more than a few stains. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-leather-draped-tabard.text:
Padded cloth armor with a leather shawl drapped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-chain-draped-tabard.text:
Padded cloth armor with a chainmail shawl draped over the shoulders.

Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-ivory-draped-tabard.text:
Padded cloth armor with a shawl in the color of ivory draped over the shoulders.

Worn by foot soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

RW-ITEM-scarlet-tabard.text:
Padded cloth armor with the telltale stains of the scarlet rot.

Worn by foot soldiers in General Radahn's army.

RW-ITEM-highwayman-cloth-armor.text: Hideously stained and ragged cloth armor. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

RW-ITEM-common-soldier-cloth-armor.text:
Cloth armor of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-armor.text:
Armor worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

RW-ITEM-shadow-militiaman-armor.text:
Armor as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

RW-ITEM-gravekeeper-cloak.text:
Thick, bristly cloak that is the symbol of an underground gravekeeper.

Those who once fought for a living were driven from the colosseum, and becoming guardians of Erdtree Burial.

RW-ITEM-nox-monk-armor.text:
Armor worn by the monks of the Eternal City, with a silk cape attached.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-nox-swordstress-armor.text:
Armor worn by swordstresses of the Eternal City. These women are the personal guards of the nightmaidens, and wear silk capes.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-night-maiden-armor.text:
Armor worn by the nightmaidens of the Eternal City. Indicates the highest clerical rank, and includes a silk cape.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-ascetic-s-loincloth.text:
Attire of the tower's ascetics, embodying their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

RW-ITEM-dirty-chainmail.text: Chainmail worn by young Albinaurics. The appearance of a protruding belly provides no benefit worthy of note.

RW-ITEM-tree-and-beast-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

The surcoat depicts the distant Erdtree and the beast regent, an
emblem of the golden lineage. Both are symbols of glory now past.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers.

The surcoat depicts twinned cuckoos peering into a flourishing mass of glintstone. To a glintstone sorcerer, the body is a transient thing. The Cuckoo alone knows its insignificance, yet watches over it all the same.

RW-ITEM-redmane-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side.

The surcoat depicts a red-maned lion raising a sword in the image of Radahn. Thus, they were Redmanes, and all proved they were worthy of the name.

RW-ITEM-erdtree-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell.

The surcoat bears a majestic likeness of the Erdtree. Its golden backing is an honor bestowed on no other soldiers.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-crest-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree.

The surcoat bears the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-surcoat.text:
Armor worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The surcoat depicts the mausoleum bell, which rings in constant mourning for the soulless demigods.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-armor.text:
Armor worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler. A ragged cloak is draped over rusted mail.

Though the chestpiece features a Scadutree motif, gold has been used for its engraving. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

RW-ITEM-exile-armor.text: Damaged armor draped with a large deep-red cloth. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

RW-ITEM-kaiden-armor.text:
Armor worn by Kaiden sellswords. Made with the pelt of a snow-wolf, which protects against the cold.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

TP-COL-LEONTIELS-ARMOR.text:
Armor comprised of a mixture of metal and hard leather, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel.

The distinctive pauldrons accentuate the wearer's graceful movements, Leontiel's own eccentric little quirk.

RW-ITEM-marionette-soldier-armor.text:
Armor of metal bands arranged in a lattice. Worn by marionette soldiers, crafted to serve the sorcerers.

The construction of this armor is remarkably crude, now rusted over and severely dented.

For a doll, the only thing that matters is that it does not break.

RW-ITEM-blue-silver-mail-armor.text:
Armor worn by females of the artificial lifeforms known as Children of Silver.

Formed of the same silver from which these beings are birthed, this is the only material that doesn't irritate their skin.

These maids constructed in Raya Lucaria headed to the Paling Tower, to enter Miquella's service.

RW-ITEM-fire-monk-armor.text:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The grotesque face sculpted on the chest is said to depict the corrupt ancient god of the flame. Taboos transform into lasting obsessions by virtue of the fear that they inspire.

RW-ITEM-blackflame-monk-armor.text:
Black iron armor adorned with ashen cloth. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

TP-COL-SILVER-GROOVED-ARMOR.text:
Silver armor whose expert craftsmanship compensates for its weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear.

The verdant green raiment is given upon receiving the guidance of grace -- even if the wearer is but a sapling at present, in time they must grow into ripened gold.

RW-ITEM-silver-grooved-armor-altered.text:
Silver armor whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear.

In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

RW-ITEM-godrick-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an
emblem of the golden lineage. The knights surely boasted of
their strength in days long gone.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a peering cuckoo, whence came their name. Perhaps the bird's shrewd gaze is an expression of their refusal to be mere servants of the academy.

RW-ITEM-redmane-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side.

When they were driven to defeat by Malenia's scarlet rot, the Redmane Knights burned the crest on the left breast of their armor to indicate their resolve.

Alas, dear home, I shan't see you again! For our duty is to remain here, a bulwark against the blight.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell.

Its left breast is emblazoned with a symbol of Erdtree Worship,
said to have once been imbued with an incantation of protection.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree.

Its left breast is emblazoned with the crest of the Haligtree. Though watered with Miquella's own blood since it was a sapling, the Haligtree ultimately failed to grow into an Erdtree.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum.

The wing-shaped ornament on its back evoke the Deathbird. A self-inflicted curse that ties the spirits of these loyal knights to the land, having willingly beheaded themselves so that they may serve their masters in death.

RW-ITEM-black-knight-armor.text:
Armor worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler.

Though the engraving above the heart is a Scadutree design, it is etched in gold. A small consolation to those forced to wage a war without grace or honor.

RW-ITEM-cleanrot-armor.text:
Armor of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

RW-ITEM-fire-knight-armor.text:
Armor of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Distinguished by its red cape and twin golden snakes which adorn the neck, enhancing incantations of Messmer's flame.

These were the only ones who truly knew Messmer. His flames, like serpents. The painful fate that accompanied his accursed form.

RW-ITEM-horned-warrior-armor.text:
Armor of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower.

The ochre fabric is draped over a chest-piece made to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

RW-ITEM-divine-beast-warrior-armor.text:
Armor of feted horned warriors chosen to become divine beast warriors, adorned with a lion's pelt.

Among the divine beast warriors, only those who truly excel at divine invocation become sculpted keepers, and are granted the honor of the lion dance.

RW-ITEM-divine-bird-warrior-armor.text:
Armor of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

TP-COL-STEEL-ARMOR.text:
Armor of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation.

A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield.

Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-armor.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-armor-altered.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. This armor was worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all accomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

RW-ITEM-fire-prelate-armor.text:
Black iron armor adorned with a red cloth. Attire of the Fire
Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity."

RW-ITEM-guardian-bracers.text:
Engraved golden bracers. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

RW-ITEM-sorcerer-manchettes.text: Manchettes worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the forearms.

TP-COL-GOLD-TATTOO-ARM.text:
An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh.

The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus.

It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule.
"Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

RW-ITEM-perfumer-gloves.text:
Gloves of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

RW-ITEM-depraved-perfumer-gloves.text: These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-gauntlets.text: Metal gauntlets covered in nicks and dents. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-highwayman-gauntlets.text: Hideously stained and dented gauntlets. Worn by former foot soldiers who have turned to banditry.

RW-ITEM-common-soldier-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

RW-ITEM-shadow-militiaman-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

RW-ITEM-nox-bracelets.text:
Monastic bracelets of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-ascetic-s-wrist-guards.text:
Wrist guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

RW-ITEM-godrick-soldier-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-raya-lucarian-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-radahn-soldier-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-soldier-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

RW-ITEM-exile-gauntlets.text: Damaged iron gauntlets. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

RW-ITEM-kaiden-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

TP-COL-LEONTIELS-GLOVES.text:
Thick leather gloves designed for real combat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel.

Affixed to the wrist with a belt-like mechanism.

RW-ITEM-blue-silver-bracelets.text:
Bracelets crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

RW-ITEM-fire-monk-gauntlets.text:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

RW-ITEM-blackflame-monk-gauntlets.text:
Black iron gauntlets featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

TP-COL-SILVER-GROOVED-GAUNTLETS.text:
Silver gauntlets whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear.

In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

RW-ITEM-godrick-knight-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time
has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-knight-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-redmane-knight-gauntlets.text: Black iron gauntlets worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-knight-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-knight-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-knight-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-black-knight-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

RW-ITEM-cleanrot-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

RW-ITEM-fire-knight-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

RW-ITEM-horned-warrior-gauntlets.text: Gauntlets of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower, made from a thick metal.

RW-ITEM-divine-bird-warrior-gauntlets.text:
Gauntlets of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The golden-hued divine birds are known to be cruel, never taking to human companionship. Those who invoked their divinity were few and far between.

TP-COL-STEEL-GAUNTLETS.text:
Gauntlets of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation.

A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield.

Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-gauntlets.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These gauntlets were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all acomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

RW-ITEM-fire-prelate-gauntlets.text:
Black iron gauntlets with the appearance of flames. Attire of
the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity.

RW-ITEM-commoner-s-shoes.text:
Modest shoes made of cloth. Standard wear for commoners in the Lands Between.

Only, there are no commoners remaining with their wits about them.

RW-ITEM-aristocrat-boots.text:
Boots made from tanned leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital.

Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-old-aristocrat-shoes.text:
Hard-wearing shoes made of leather. Travel attire worn by nobles in the capital. Garb favored by the aged.
Abandoning their birthplace after the Shattering, these undead wanderers are the pitiful product of undending life.

RW-ITEM-page-trousers.text:
Trousers worn by pages who serve the nobility and are mindful to keep them out of harm's way.

Traveling wear tailored with exquisite precision, to avoid any undue shame for the page's master.

RW-ITEM-guardian-greaves.text:
Engraved golden greaves. Worn by the guardians of the Minor Erdtrees.

In accordance with an ancient pact with the Erdtree, it is said that their deaths led not to destruction, but instead to renewed, eternal life as guardians.

RW-ITEM-sorcerer-leggings.text: Leggings worn by Raya Lucaria's scholars of sorcery. Made by wrapping a simple cloth around the legs.

TP-COL-GOLD-TATTOO-LEG.text:
An intricate tattoo, etched into the flesh.

The work of the honorable Goldmask's closest disciple, and dear friend, who accompanied him on his great venture. Increases faith to the detriment of focus.

It is an artificial tongue, created to express the Golden Order itself, now an unrelenting curse that binds the entire body with its rule.
"Do your utmost, to rid yourself of doubt."

RW-ITEM-perfumer-sarong.text:
Sarong of an Erdtree Capital perfumer.

In times of past, the role of perfumer was much respected; a blessed apothecary in the eyes of the many. But after entering the battlefields of the Shattering they performed no such role, trading their aromatics for poisons and explosives.

RW-ITEM-depraved-perfumer-trousers.text:
Trousers worn by depraved perfumers.

These heresy-inclined perfumers imbibe their own spices to alter body and mind. Their slow descent into self-destruction is what earned them their name.

RW-ITEM-fur-leggings.text:
Leggings fashioned from a bristly pelt. Worn by ancestral follower warriors.

The ancestral followers keep their distance from the Erdtree, awaiting new buds. They are certain to sprout from their very flesh, and indeed, their souls.

RW-ITEM-foot-soldier-greaves.text: Metal greaves that have already been mended countless times. Widely issued to foot soldiers in a lord's army.

RW-ITEM-common-soldier-greaves.text:
Greaves of the rank-and-file soldiers of Messmer's army.

A pitch-dark soot clings to it, much like the inner faces of the men who wore them.

RW-ITEM-vulgar-militia-greaves.text:
Greaves worn by lean, mean, and filthy militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excized from the memory of history. This is where the vulgar militia serve, as untiring, unsung watchkeepers.

RW-ITEM-shadow-militiaman-greaves.text:
Greaves as dark as shadow, worn by vulgar militiamen.

Freshly-singed battlegrounds effusing with the stench of the dead. Forbidden lands that will be excised from the memory of history. What better place than the realms of shadow then, for such an army?

RW-ITEM-duelist-greaves.text:
Greaves encircled by bronze snakes. Worn by gladiators who were driven from the colosseum. The wearer becomes a slightly easier target for foes.

The snake is viewed as a traitor to the Erdtree, and the audience delighted in seeing these bronze effigies beaten and battered.

RW-ITEM-nox-greaves.text:
Monastic greaves of the Eternal City.

Long ago, the Nox invoked the ire of the Greater Will, and were banished deep underground. Now they live under a false night sky, in eternal anticipation of their liege. Of the coming age of the stars. And their Lord of Night.

RW-ITEM-ascetic-s-ankle-guards.text:
Ankle guards of the tower's ascetics which embody their commitment to an austere existence of strict self-control.

In order to ascend from their mortal flesh into tutelary deities of the land, they heighten their spirituality through severe ascetic training.

RW-ITEM-godrick-soldier-greaves.text:
Greaves worn by soldiers loyal to Godrick the Grafted.
Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-raya-lucarian-greaves.text: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy soldiers. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-radahn-soldier-greaves.text: Greaves worn by soldiers who fought by General Radahn's side. Rust worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-soldier-greaves.text: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to defend the royal capital of Leyndell. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-greaves.text: Greaves worn by soldiers sworn to the Haligtree. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-greaves.text: Greaves worn by headless soldiers who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Rust-worn and stained through unending conflict.

RW-ITEM-messmer-soldier-greaves.text: Greaves worn by soldiers who serve Messmer the Impaler, rusted and crusted in filth from fighting in unending war.

RW-ITEM-exile-greaves.text: Damaged iron greaves. Worn by soldiers sent to the penal colonies.

RW-ITEM-kaiden-trousers.text:
Trousers worn by Kaiden sellswords.

These hulking, fearless mercenaries, said to hail from the moutaintops of the wintry north, are adept at fighting on horseback. Kaiden is the name of their home settlement.

TP-COL-LEONTIELS-BOOTS.text:
Leather boots designed for real combat, favored protective gear of the knight Leontiel.

The fold-overs have been tanned a contrasting white.

RW-ITEM-blue-silver-mail-skirt.text:
Chainmail skirt crafted with blue silver. Worn by the wolf-riding Albinauric archers.

Blue silver is a metal born from the same mother as the archers themselves, and provides protection from magic and frost.

RW-ITEM-fire-monk-greaves.text:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Fire Monks.

The Fire Monks are guardians of the flame of ruin, forbidden by the Erdtree and said to be kept high in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

RW-ITEM-blackflame-monk-greaves.text:
Black iron greaves featuring a flame motif. Attire of the Blackflame Monks.

The Blackflame Monks, enthralled by the god-slaying black flame, became traitors, abandoning their posts as guardians. The seduction of a taboo is never easily spurned.

TP-COL-SILVER-GROOVED-GREAVES.text:
Silver greaves whose expert craftsmanship compensates for their weight. The construction is extremely thin, but the beautifully etched grooves reinforce its strength as protective gear.

In the land of Idus delicacy is no weakness.

RW-ITEM-godrick-knight-greaves.text:
Greaves worn by knights loyal to Godrick the Grafted. Time
has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-cuckoo-knight-greaves.text: Greaves worn by Raya Lucaria Academy knights. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-redmane-knight-greaves.text: Black iron greaves worn by knights who fought by General Radahn's side. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-leyndell-knight-greaves.text:
Greaves worn by knights sworn to defend the royal capital of
Leyndell. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-knight-greaves.text: Greaves worn by knights sworn to the Haligtree. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-mausoleum-knight-greaves.text: Greaves worn by headless knights who endlessly guard the Wandering Mausoleum. Time has yet to dull their luster.

RW-ITEM-black-knight-greaves.text:
Greaves worn by the Black Knights, servants of Messmer the Impaler. Black iron ornamented with gold. A rotten odor stubbornly clings to it.

Perhaps it arises from the tainted nature of the blood that splattered upon it. Or perhaps it is the wearer's own blackened soul, festering after endless slaughter.

RW-ITEM-cleanrot-greaves.text:
Greaves of the Cleanrot Knights, celebrated for their undefeated campaign in the Shattering.

The Cleanrot Knights vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the inevitable, if gradual, putrefaction of their flesh. Their acceptance of their fate made these battles the fiercest of all.

RW-ITEM-fire-knight-greaves.text:
Greaves of the Fire Knights under Messmer the Impaler's personal command.

Each and every knight hailed from a renowned family of the Erdtree's upper echelons, but were shunned and chased from their homes after pledging allegiance to Messmer as their master.

RW-ITEM-horned-warrior-greaves.text: Greaves of the horned warriors, keepers of the tower. Shaped to resemble the unclothed form of a hero from older times.

RW-ITEM-divine-bird-warrior-greaves.text:
Greaves of divine bird warriors, the very first of all horned warriors, made from a golden metal.

The great, sharp talons increase the force generated by kicks.

TP-COL-STEEL-GREAVES.text:
Greaves of thick steel with black luster. Very weighty, but boasts high damage negation.

A piece of protective gear for those who rely only on themselves upon the battlefield.

Whether putting your foes to the sword in glorious victory or fleeing a deadly onslaught, first must you remain among the standing.

RW-ITEM-banished-knight-greaves.text:
Thick, full set of armor covering the entire body. These greaves were worn by knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes.

These fierce warriors were each and all acomplished. Perhaps that is why, despite their territorial losses, they were still named knights.

RW-ITEM-fire-prelate-greaves.text:
Black iron greaves with the appearance of flames. Attire of
the Fire Prelates, commanders of the Fire Monks.

The weighty frames of the Prelates symbolized the onus of
their grave vows as guardians of the flame. "Etch this sight upon
thine breast. Of my thunderous gravity.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-stamp-upward-cut.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Stamp (Upward Cut): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for an upward strike.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-stamp-sweep.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Stamp (Sweep): Brace armament and step into a low stance that prevents recoil from most enemy attacks. Follow up with a strong attack for a sweeping strike.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small and medium swords excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-wild-strikes.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Wild Strikes: Swing armament with wild abandon. Hold to continue swinging. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack.

Usable on axes and hammers as well as curved swords and greatswords (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-lion-s-claw.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Lion's Claw: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers
(small armaments and thrusting swords excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-savage-lion-s-claw.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Savage Lion's Claw: Skill of the particularly brave, even among the Redmanes. Somersault forwards, striking foes with armament. An additional strike may be performed with an additional input.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers (small armaments and thrusting swords excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-cragblade.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Cragblade: Skill that manipulates gravity. Bury the armament in the ground, pulling rocks from the earth to reinforce it. Increases attack power and makes it easier to break enemy stance.

Usable on melee armaments (whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-spinning-gravity-thru.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Spinning Gravity Thrust: A gravity skill honed by the disciples of an Alabaster Lord. Uses gravitational power to hang in the air before rotating the body and charging forward. An additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

Usable on large and colossal swords.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-kick.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Kick: Push an enemy back with a high kick. Effective against enemies who are guarding, and can break a foe's stance. Sometimes a simple tool is the most effective.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-endure.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Endure: Assume an anchored stance to brace for incoming attacks, briefly boosting poise. Damage taken while using this skill is reduced.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-ground-slam.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Ground Slam: Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends a powerful shockwave in all directions.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-earthshaker.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Earthshaker: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash an earth-shaking shockwave. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.

Usable on greataxes, great hammers, great spears, and colossal weapons.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-hoarah-loux-s-earthsh.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Hoarah Loux's Earthshaker: Slam both hands onto the ground to violently shake the earth and unleash a shockwave. Follow up with an additional input to slam the ground again.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-war-cry.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

War Cry: Give a war cry to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to charging attacks.

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-barbaric-roar.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Barbaric Roar: Let loose a bestial roar to rally the spirit and increase attack power. While active, strong attacks change to savage combo attacks.

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-braggart-s-roar.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Braggart's Roar: Declare your presence with a boastful roar. Raises attack power, defense, and stamina recovery speed.

Usable on melee armaments (daggers, thrusting swords, and whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-troll-s-roar.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Heavy affinity and the following skill:

Troll's Roar: Look into the distance and let out an intense roar, generating a powerful shockwave that blows back surrounding foes. Follow up with a strong attack to slam the armament down.

Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-spinning-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Spinning Slash: Skill favored by dexterous warriors. Slash foes as your body spins. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-impaling-thrust.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Impaling Thrust: Skill that lets piercing armaments overcome enemy shields. Build power, then lunge forward for a strong thrust that pierces an enemy's guard.

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-blind-spot.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Blind Spot: Leap into close quarters to take advantage of the enemy's blind spot and gore them from the side. Inputs determine which side you attack from. This attack slips below the opponent's guard.

Usable on backhand blades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-swift-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Swift Slash: A skill passed down amongst hornsent swordsmen. Take a swift forward step to slice through foes. This sharp strike also fires off a shearing vacuum. Can be charged to increase the skill's power and the distance of the forward step.

Usable on backhand blades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-piercing-fang.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:
