Piercing Fang: Skill used by Yura, the Bloody Finger Hunter. Starting with the blade held horizontally, make a powerful thrust that cannot be blocked.

Usable on medium and large armaments capable of thrusting.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-repeating-thrust.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Repeating Thrust: Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts.

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-double-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Double Slash: Skill of superior swordsmen. Perform a crossing slash attack from a low stance. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

Usable on swords and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-sword-dance.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Sword Dance: Quickly close in to perform a series of spinning upward slashes. Follow up with an additional input to finish with a downward slash.

Usable on swords, axes, and polearms capable of slashing (colossal weapons and great spears excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-unsheathe.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Unsheathe: Skill of swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Sheathe blade, holding it at the hip in a composed stance. Follow up with a normal or strong attack to perform a swift slash attack.

Usable on katana.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-overhead-stance.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Overhead Stance: A skill that starts with the blade held high in a ready stance. Execute a normal attack from this stance to step forward and slash downwards, or a strong attack to deliver a series of downward slashes.

Usable on great katana.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-quickstep.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Quickstep: Skill prized by the crafty and fleet of foot. Perform a quickstep maneuver that allows for circling around lock-on targets.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-bloodhound-s-step.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Bloodhound's Step: Skill that allows the user to become temporarily invisible while dodging at high speed. Moves faster and travels farther than a regular quickstep. This skill can be used to circle around lock-on targets.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-raptor-of-the-mists.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Raptor of the Mists: Duck into a low stance, momentarily vanishing. If an enemy attack connects, avian wings will allow for a quick escape into the air.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-beast-s-roar.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Beast's Roar: Unleash a beastly roar, rending the air as a forward-travelling projectile.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-savage-claws.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Savage Claws: Pounce like a beast to viciously slash into foe with left and right claws.

Usable on beast claws.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-raging-beast.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Raging Beast: Step with the swiftness of a beast, leap high, and slash foe from above. Initial step can be taken forward, backward, left, or right. Strong attack allows for a follow-up attack.

Usable on beast claws.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-piercing-throw.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Piercing Throw: Throw armament with a powerful spin, causing it to bore through foes. When using this skill, the armament can be thrown further than normal and also pierce through enemies.

Usable on throwing blades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-scattershot-throw.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Keen affinity and the following skill:

Scattershot Throw: Employ smithing arts to conjure multiple copies of the armament in both hands and throw them all at once. Follow up with an additional input to throw again.

Usable on throwing blades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-square-off.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Square Off: This skill starts with the sword held level. Follow up with a normal attack to slash upwards through enemy's guard, or a strong attack to perform a running thrust.

Usable on straight swords.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-wing-stance.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Wing Stance: Calmly assume a right-sided stance. Normal attack triggers a rapid three-slash combination. Strong attack triggers a leaping thrust.

Usable on light greatswords.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-charge-forth.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Charge Forth: Quickly charge forward with the armament at the hip, carrying the momentum into a thrust. Hold to cover a greater distance.

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-spinning-strikes.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Spinning Strikes: Polearm skill that performs continuous spinning attacks. Hold to continue the attack. Can be followed up with a normal or strong attack. Nullifies projectiles such as arrows while spinning.

Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-giant-hunt.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Giant Hunt: Skill developed for confronting gigantic foes. Step forward from a low stance, carrying the momentum into a sudden upward thrust.

Usable on large and colossal weapons capable of thrusting, spears, and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-storm-blade.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Storm Blade: Lost skill of Stormveil. Surround armament with shearing storm winds that can be fired forward. Can be fired in rapid succession.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons and twinblades excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-storm-assault.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Storm Assault: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Leap forward through surrounding storm winds and thrust armament downward. The attack will produce more storm winds at the point of impact.

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting, heavy thrusting swords, and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-stormcaller.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Stormcaller: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Spin armament to create surrounding storm winds. Repeated inputs allow for up to two follow-up attacks.

Usable on swords capable of slashing, axes, hammers, and polearms (small and colossal weapons excepted)

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-storm-stomp.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Storm Stomp: One of the skills that channel the tempests of Stormveil. Stomp hard on the ground to kick up a momentary storm.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-vacuum-slice.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Vacuum Slice: Lost skill of ancient heroes. Hold the armament aloft to surround it with a shearing vacuum, then launch it forwards as a blade-like projectile.

Usable on swords and axes (colossal axes excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-phantom-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Phantom Slash: Skill inspired by the fond remembrances of the Night's Cavalry. Creates an apparition of the knights' former instructor who guides a joint lunging upward swing. Additional input allows for a follow-up attack.

Usable on polearms and twinblades (great spears excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-determination.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Determination: A knightly skill. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, powering up your next attack.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-royal-knight-s-resolv.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Quality affinity and the following skill:

Royal Knight's Resolve: Skill of the knights who once served the Elden Lord. Hold the flat of the armament to your face and pledge your resolve, greatly powering up your next attack.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-glintstone-pebble.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Glintstone Pebble: Skill that employs the glintstone sorcery of the same name. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust, performed while the armament is still imbued with glintstone.

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-glintblade-phalanx.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Glintblade Phalanx: Skill used by the enchanted knights who served the Carian royal family. Form an arch of magic glintblades overhead, which will attack foes automatically. Follow up with a strong attack to chain this skill into a lunging thrust.

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-carian-greatsword.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Carian Greatsword: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-carian-grandeur.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Carian Grandeur: Carian royal prestige embodied in a skill. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and swing it down. Can be charged to increase its power by up to two levels.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-carian-sovereignty.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Carian Sovereignty: Skill passed down the Carian royal family. Transform blade into a magical greatsword and bring it down. Additional input follows up with a horizontal sweep. Charge either attack to enhance potency.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-spinning-weapon.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Spinning Weapon: Defensive skill employed by Carian princesses. Lifts armament into mid-air, then makes it spin violently. Those it touches will suffer successive attacks.

Usable on small and medium swords, axes, and hammers, as well as polearms and staves (great spears excepted)

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-loretta-s-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Loretta's Slash: Skill of Loretta the Royal Knight. Leap forward, imbuing the blade with glintstone, then descend, accelerating into a sweeping slash.

Usable on polearms and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-waves-of-darkness.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Waves of Darkness: Plunge armament into the ground to release three waves of darkness. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.

Usable on greataxes, great hammers, great spears, and colossal weapons.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-gravitas.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Gravitas: Skill originating from the Alabaster Lords, who had skin of stone. Thrust the armament into the ground to create a gravity well. In addition to dealing damage, this attack pulls enemies in.

Usable on melee armaments (small armaments and whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-flaming-strike.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

Flaming Strike: Skill that emits flame in a wide frontward arc. Follow up with a strong attack to perform a lunging, sweeping strike. This will also coat the armament in fire.

Usable on melee armaments (colossal weapons and whips excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-flame-of-the-redmanes.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

Flame of the Redmanes: Skill of the Redmanes, who fought alongside General Radahn. Produce a powerful burst of flames in a wide frontward arc.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-eruption.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Fire affinity and the following skill:

Eruption: Skill of the knights who serve at Volcano Manor. Slam armament into the ground, spawning roiling lava which spouts up upon release.

Usable on large and colossal swords, axes, and hammers.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-prelate-s-charge.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

Prelate's Charge: Slam armament into the ground to create a surge of flames, then charge in. Hold to continue the charge.

Usable on large and colossal axes and hammers.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-black-flame-tornado.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

Black Flame Tornado: Spin armament overhead and then plunge it into the ground to summon a raging vortex of black flames. Hold to create an initial flame tornado while spinning the armament.

Usable on polearms and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-flame-skewer.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

Flame Skewer: Skill of Queelign of the Fire Knights. Enwreathe armament in flame and assume a low stance before skewering the enemy in a single motion. Strong attack unleashes a follow-up flame attack.

Usable on medium and large armaments capable of thrusting.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-flame-spear.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Flame Art affinity and the following skill:

Flame Spear: Skill of Kood, captain of the Fire Knights. Ready weapon for a thrusting attack and unleash a spear of flame straight ahead. Charge the attack to increase damage dealt and distance travelled.

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting (claws and backhand blades excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-thunderbolt.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

Thunderbolt: Skill used by the capital's ancient dragon cult. Raise armament aloft to call down a bolt of lightning. Can be fired in rapid succession.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-lightning-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

Lightning Slash: Call down a bolt of lightning into armament, then swing it down to create an explosive shock. The armament retains the lightning enchantment for a while.

Usable on swords, axes, and hammers.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-blinkbolt.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

Blinkbolt: Skill used by the golden knights who served Godwyn. From a low stance, the body is transformed into a bolt of lightning and charges straight ahead at fulgurous speed.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-lightning-ram.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Lightning affinity and the following skill:

Lightning Ram: Skill inspired by tumbling rams. Let out a bleat, then tumble forwards, clad in lightning. Tumbles can be repeated in rapid succession.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-sacred-blade.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Sacred Blade: Grants armament's attacks holy essence and fires off a golden blade projectile. The armament retains its holy essence for a while.

Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-prayerful-strike.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Prayerful Strike: Raise armament aloft in prayer, then slam it into the ground. This inspired blow restores HP to the self and nearby allies if it successfully hits.

Usable on axes and hammers.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-sacred-ring-of-light.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Sacred Ring of Light: Skill used by the commanders of the Cleanrot Knights. Gather a sacred ring of light in the armament, then fire it forwards. Can be fired in rapid succession.

Usable on polearms (great spears excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-sacred-order.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Sacred Order: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Perform a salute and grant the armament holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-shared-order.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Shared Order: Skill of the Golden Order fundamentalist knights. Grant the armament and those of nearby allies holy essence. Highly effective against Those Who Live in Death.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-golden-land.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Land: Thrust armament into the ground, then gather strength to unleash a blast of sacred energy that coalesces into golden darts. Follow up with a strong attack to swing the armament in a sweeping strike.

Usable on greataxes, great hammers, great spears, and colossal weapons.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-golden-slam.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Slam: Skill of the avatars who protect Minor Erdtrees. Jump up high into the air and crash down on the ground ahead. The resulting pratfall sends golden shockwaves in all directions.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-golden-vow.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Vow: Skill passed down from antiquity among the knights of the capital. Raise armament aloft and pledge to honor the Erdtree in battle, granting self and nearby allies increased attack power and defense.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-vow-of-the-indomitabl.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Vow of the Indomitable: Skill of the ancient warriors of the Erdtree. Hold shield aloft to imbue yourself with golden power, granting momentary invincibility.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-holy-ground.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Holy Ground: Raise shield to create an Erdtree-consecrated area that continuously restores HP and boosts defense for self and allies inside it.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-aspects-of-the-crucib.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Aspects of the Crucible (Wings): This skill originates from the lifeforms of the Crucible. Grow a golden pair of wings and take to the air before diving down at the foe, weapon first. A spinning attack is performed when wielding a twinblade.

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-poisonous-mist.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:

Poisonous Mist: Bathe armament in poison, and then slash, spreading toxic mist forwards. The armament retains its poison for a while.

Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-poison-moth-flight.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:

Poison Moth Flight: Slash with a poison-infused blade. If the follow-up strike lands on a poisoned foe, it will deal significant damage.

Usable on small and medium swords (twinblades excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-the-poison-flower-blo.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Poison affinity and the following skill:

The Poison Flower Blooms Twice: Conjures stingers of scarlet rot from below to stab the enemy. Landing a follow-up attack on a foe already inflicted with poison or rot deals massive damage in one fell swoop.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-blood-blade.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

Blood Blade: Wound self to coat the armament with blood, then unleash an airborne blood blade that causes hemorrhaging. Can be fired in rapid succession.

Usable on small and medium swords.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-bloody-slash.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

Bloody Slash: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. From a low stance, coat the blade in your own blood to unleash a rending blood slash in a wide arc.

Usable on swords (colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-blood-tax.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

Blood Tax: Blood Oath skill granted by the Lord of Blood. Twist to build power, then unleash a flurry of thrusts that rob the target of both their blood and their HP.

Usable on armaments capable of thrusting
(colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-seppuku.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Blood affinity and the following skill:

Seppuku: A forbidden technique used by swordsmen from the Land of Reeds. Plunge the blade into your stomach to stain it with blood. Increases attack power and improves ability to inflict blood loss.

Usable on swords as well as polearms capable of thrusting (small and colossal weapons excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-ice-spear.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

Ice Spear: Skill of the warriors who served Lunar Princess Ranni. Spin armament to release cold magic, then channel it into a piercing spear of ice.

Usable on polearms capable of thrusting and twinblades.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-chilling-mist.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

Chilling Mist: Coat armament in frost, and then slash, spreading frigid mist forwards. The armament retains its frost for a while.

Usable on melee armaments (whips, fists, and claws excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-ghostflame-call.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

Ghostflame Call: Thrust out armament to summon ghostflame. Follow up with a normal attack to set the ground ablaze with ghostflame, or a strong attack to trigger a massive explosion.

Usable on swords and spears (small armaments, twinblades, and backhand blades excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-hoarfrost-stomp.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

Hoarfrost Stomp: Stomp hard to spread a trail of freezing mist on the ground. The mist applies the frost status effect.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-divine-beast-frost-st.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Cold affinity and the following skill:

Divine Beast Frost Stomp: A skill which imitates the wrath of the divine beast's dance. Lift a leg up high and stamp it down with great force. Sends a powerful wave of frost straight out along the ground. Can be charged to increase power and range.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-spectral-lance.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

Spectral Lance: Skill of the headless Mausoleum Knights. Hurl a phantasmic spear at foes.

Usable on polearms (reapers excepted).

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-lifesteal-fist.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

Lifesteal Fist: Skill that demonstrates mastery of the art of controlling vital energies. A slow, controlled punch with an energy-infused fist that renders foes unconscious and steals their HP. Only effective against foes of human build.

Usable on fists and claws.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-white-shadow-s-lure.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

White Shadow's Lure: Hold armament in a brief, silent prayer to create a white shadow. The apparition lures in foes of human build who are not in combat, drawing their aggression. Effective on demi-humans even if they are already in a combat state.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-assassin-s-gambit.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

Assassin's Gambit: Skill that masks the user's presence at the cost of a self-inflicted wound. Grants near-invisibility and silences footsteps.

Usable on small and medium straight swords and thrusting swords.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-shriek-of-sorrow.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Occult affinity and the following skill:

Shriek of Sorrow: Skill utilized by the downtrodden. Scream, causing nearby enemies to flinch, while also recalling deep-seated resentment, boosting attack power based on the amount of HP remaining. The lower the HP, the greater the effect.

Usable on all melee armaments.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-palm-blast.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Palm Blast: Skill of the spiritual seekers known as the Dryleaf Sect. Imbues hand with energy before using a palm strike to unleash an explosive blast. The already formidable power and impact can be bolstered by charging the attack.

Usable on hand-to-hand weapons.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-dryleaf-whirlwind.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Dryleaf Whirlwind: This skill represents the pinnacle of Dane's footwork-based martial artistry. Rise into the air with a series of spinning kicks before crashing down with one final strike. Imbues kicking attacks with energy, increasing their range.

Usable on hand-to-hand weapons.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-wall-of-sparks.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Wall of Sparks: Scatter perfumed powder in vicinity, producing intense sparks after a brief delay. Can be charged to increase power and range. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.

Usable on perfume bottles.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-rolling-sparks.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Rolling Sparks: Scatter perfumed powder before you, triggering rolling explosions of deadly sparks. The properties of the sparks are determined by the perfume bottle used.

Usable on perfume bottles.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-mighty-shot.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Mighty Shot: Archery skill performed from an oblique stance. Ready the bow, then pull the bowstring to its limit to enhance the power of the shot, penetrating the enemy's guard.

Usable on light bows and longbows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-through-and-through.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Through and Through: Powerful archery skill using a greatbow held in an oblique stance. Ready the greatbow, then twist the bowstring to fire a mighty greatarrow that can penetrate through enemies.

Usable on greatbows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-igon-s-drake-hunt.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Igon's Drake Hunt: Skill of Igon, drake warrior. Ready the bow before unleashing a twisted shot with a great bellow that considerably enhances its power.

Usable on greatbows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-barrage.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Barrage: Archery skill using a bow held horizontally. Ready the bow, then fire off a rapid succession of shots faster than the eye can see.

Usable on light bows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-sky-shot.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Sky Shot: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire an arrow high up into the air, arcing so as to strike the enemy from above when it comes down.

Usable on light bows and longbows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-enchanted-shot.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Enchanted Shot: Archery skill that enlivens the arrow with spiritual essence. The resulting shot will fly faster than regular shots and change its trajectory to follow the target.

Usable on light bows and longbows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-rain-of-arrows.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Rain of Arrows: Archery skill performed from a low stance. Ready the bow, then fire a burst of arrows into the sky to shower the enemy with projectiles.

Usable on all bows.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-parry.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Parry: Use this skill in time with a foe's melee attack to deflect it and break that foe's stance. This provides an opening to perform a critical hit.

Usable on daggers, curved swords, thrusting swords, fists, claws, and small and medium shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-golden-parry.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Sacred affinity and the following skill:

Golden Parry: Perform an Erdtree incantation and swing the shield to deflect enemy attacks and break their stance. Effective even at a slight distance.

Usable on small and medium shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-storm-wall.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Storm Wall: Swing the shield to create a wall of storm winds in front of you, deflecting arrows and other such physical projectiles. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.

Usable on small and medium shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-shield-bash.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Shield Bash: Brace behind shield before using bodyweight to ram foes while maintaining guarding stance. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards, and can even be staggered.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-shield-crash.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Shield Crash: Two-hand the shield and charge forwards while maintaining guard. Weaker enemies will be shoved backwards and can even be staggered. Hold to extend the duration of the charge forwards.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-barricade-shield.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Barricade Shield: Skill made famous by Sir Neidhardt. Focus your energy into the shield, temporarily hardening it to deflect greater blows.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-thops-s-barrier.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Thops's Barrier: Erect a magical forcefield while swinging the shield to deflect sorceries and incantations. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.

Usable on small and medium shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-carian-retaliation.text:
This Ash of War grants an armament the Magic affinity and the following skill:

Carian Retaliation: Swing the shield to dispel incoming sorceries and incantations, transforming the magic into retaliatory glintblades. Can also be used in the same way as a regular parry.

Usable on small and medium shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-shield-strike.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament, but imparts the following skill:

Shield Strike: A skill that uses the shield to attack. Repeated inputs allow for up to three follow-up attacks.

Usable on all shields.

RW-ITEM-ash-of-war-no-skill.text:
This Ash of War grants no affinity to an armament and replaces any skill present with the following:

No skill: This armament has no skill. If the armament in the other hand has a skill, that skill will be used instead.

Usable on shields and torches.

RW-ITEM-rykard-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune of the shardbearer Rykard.
Its blessing restores HP upon defeating enemies.
Rykard was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika.
But Rykard fed himself to the blasphemous serpent, Great Rune and all.

RW-ITEM-radahn-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune of the shardbearer Radahn.
Its blessing raises maximum HP, FP and Stamina.

Radahn was amongst the children of Rennala and Radagon, who became demigod stepchildren after Radagon's union with Queen Marika.

The Great Rune burns, to resist the encroachment of scarlet rot.

RW-ITEM-morgott-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune of the shardbearer Morgott.
Its blessing greatly raises maximum HP.
This Great Rune is the anchor ring that houses the base, and proves two things:
That the Omen King was born of the golden lineage and that he was indeed the Lord of Leyndell.

RW-ITEM-mohg-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune of the shardbearer Mohg.
Its blessing grants a blessing of blood to summoned phantoms, and imparts a phantom Great Rune upon successful invasion.
Mohg and Morgott are twin brothers, and their Great Runes are naturally similar.
But Mohg's rune is soaked in accursed blood, from his devout love for the wretched mire that he was born into far below the earth.

RW-ITEM-malenia-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune of the shardbearer Malenia.
The blessing of this half-rotted rune reduces the healing power of Flask of Crimson Tears.

And yet, due to the infusion of Malenia's spirit of resistance, attacks made immediately after receiving damage will partially recover HP.

Malenia is daughter to Queen Marika and Radagon, and her Great Rune should have been the most sacred of all.

RW-ITEM-great-rune-of-the-unborn.text:
Amber egg clutched by Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Great Rune of unborn demigods.

Perfects those who have been born anew.

Children born anew by Rennala are all frail and short-lived. Imperfect beings, each and all

RW-ITEM-mending-rune-of-perfect-order.text:
Rune discovered by the noble Goldmask. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord.

A Rune of transcendental ideology which will attempt to perfect the Golden Order.

The current imperfection of the Golden Order, or instability of ideology, can be blamed upon the fickleness of the gods no better than men. That is the fly in the ointment.

RW-ITEM-mending-rune-of-the-death-prince.text:
Rune gestated by Fia, the Deathbed Companion. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord.

Formed of the two hallowbrand half-wheels combined, it will embed the principle of life within Death into Order.

The Golden Order was created by confining Destined Death. Thus, this new Order will be one of Death restored.

RW-ITEM-mending-rune-of-the-fell-curse.text:
Loathsome rune gestated by the Dung Eater. Used to restore the fractured Elden Ring when brandished by the Elden Lord.

The reviled curse will last eternally, and the world's children, grandchildren, and every generation hence, will be its pustules.

If Order is defiled entirely, defilement is defilement no more, and for every curse, a cursed blessing.

RW-ITEM-drawing-room-key.text:
Key to Volcano Manor's drawing room.

The door can be found in the westward corridor, upon the left hand side.

RW-ITEM-sewer-gaol-key.text:
Filthy key received from the Dung Eater.

Unlocks sewer-gaol door said to lie beneath Leyndell, the Royal Capital.

RW-ITEM-discarded-palace-key.text:
A key discarded by Lunar Princess Ranni alongside her very flesh.

Opens a treasure chest passed down to Carian Princesses.

It is said to be found in the Grand Library of Raya Lucaria with her mother Rennala.

RW-ITEM-academy-glintstone-key.text:
Key to the seals binding both gates to the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

Activates warp magic bound within the seals.

A glintstone key will remember its user, meaning once used it can never be passed on to another. The academy does not welcome the indolent.

RW-ITEM-sellian-sealbreaker.text:
Glintstone key received from the sorceress Sellen.

Capable of breaking the seal that keeps Master Lusat confined.

Sellia, Town of Sorcery can be found in Caelid. This key was said to have been found in the possession of a Sellian sorcerer.

RW-ITEM-carian-inverted-statue.text:
Statuette of a scholar, with ground and sky inverted.

Reveals the hidden form of the Carian Study Hall, which connects to the divine tower.

To unveil the secret, affix it to the pedestal of the celestial globe.

RW-ITEM-dectus-medallion-right.text:
Right half of a split medallion depicting the Erdtree.

Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Dectus, connecting the Altus Plateau to Liurnia.

The left half is said to reside in the coastal Fort Haight to the far west.

RW-ITEM-rold-medallion.text:
Conjoined split medallion depicting the Flame Peak.

Brandishing the medallion activates the Grand Lift of Rold, connecting Leyndell to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

The forge of the flame of ruin is said to be found upon their peaks, and it is here Melina wishes to travel in resuming your journey together.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-secret-medallion-left.text:
Left half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree.

Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path.

In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

RW-ITEM-haligtree-secret-medallion-right.text:
Right half of a split medallion depicting the Haligtree.

Brandishing the medallion with both halves conjoined will activate the Grand Lift of Rold, granting access to a hidden path.

In other words, this secret medallion will guide the bearer to the land of Miquella's Haligtree.

RW-ITEM-well-depths-key.text:
A crude, corroded key.

Opens the iron grating at the bottom of the well in Belurat, the tower settlement.

RW-ITEM-storeroom-key.text:
A key with a spiral engraving.

Opens the door to the storeroom on the second floor of Belurat, the tower settlement.

RW-ITEM-prayer-room-key.text:
Iron key with an engraved crest.

Opens the door to the prayer room in the house of worship found in the church district of the shadow keep.

RW-ITEM-gaol-upper-level-key.text:
A frozen iron key.

Opens the iron grating on the upper level of the Lamenter's Gaol.

RW-ITEM-gaol-lower-level-key.text:
A frozen iron key.

Opens the iron grating on the lower level of the Lamenter's Gaol.

TP-COL-REGALIA-TREE-SENTINEL.text:
A smaller version of the solemn gold armor that adorns the warhorses of the Tree Sentinels who serve the Erdtree.

One of several liveries once prepared for spectral steeds, which allows Torrent, through grace, to change his appearance.

Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

TP-COL-REGALIA-CARIAN-SILVER.text:
The richly ornamented white silver armor of the Carian Royal line is a one-of-a-kind item made for a certain spectral steed, once forged in the lands of the Three Sisters.

It is through grace that the spectral steed Torrent's appearance may be changed.

Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

TP-COL-REGALIA-FUNEREAL-NIGHT.text:
A smaller version of the sable attire used to adorn and conceal the warhorses of the Night's Cavalry.

One of several liveries once prepared for spectral steeds, which allows Torrent, through grace, to change his appearance.

Though a spectral steed's form will change when vested in this garb, their heart will remain the same.

RW-ITEM-miquella-s-great-rune.text:
A Great Rune relinquished by Miquella.

Broken and bereft of its bounty, it retains naught but the power to resist charms.

Miquella set off for the tower enshrouded by shadow, abandoning everything—his golden flesh, his blinding strength, even his fate.

All in an effort to bury the original sin. To embrace the whole of it, and be reborn as a new god.

RW-ITEM-note-gateway.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

Fort Gael in Caelid houses a gateway that leads to Redmane Castle.

RW-ITEM-note-hidden-cave.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

There is a hidden cave in the town of Sellia. Look beyond the graveyard at the precipice.

RW-ITEM-note-the-preceptor-s-secret.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"Preceptor Seluvis is hiding a dirty secret in a cellar among the ruins not far from the sisters three.

The vile Graven Witch seems to be a frequent visitor to that place."

RW-ITEM-note-below-the-capital.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"Below the royal capital of Leyndell is a vast network of sewers.

The well in the city below reaches deep into its tunnels."

RW-ITEM-note-gravity-s-advantage.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

Gravitational power that pulls can bring flying foes low.

RW-ITEM-note-revenants.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"The crawling royal revenants and their followers are all cursed.

Healing powers will harm rather than mend."

RW-ITEM-note-flame-chariots.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"Beware the Fire Monks' chariots bearing the faces of giants.

A well-aimed blow to the chimney on top may prove effective, but opportunities for a plunging attack will be rare indeed."

RW-ITEM-note-unseen-assassins.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"Some assassins cannot be seen with the naked eye.

Seems the Erdtree sentries once carried torches that could cast light on these prowlers."

RW-ITEM-note-imp-shades.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

"Nothing can touch the shades of imps in the heroes' graveyard.

Only Rosus's light can give them form."

RW-ITEM-note-frenzied-flame-village.text:
Note sold by a nomadic merchant imparting knowledge in brief.

South of the Grand Lift of Dectus lies the Frenzied Flame Village, inhabited by the sick. Stay well away.

RW-ITEM-note-the-lord-of-frenzied-flame.text:
Note written by a nomadic merchant succinctly detailing knowledge acquired.

Beneath Leyndell, at the very bottom lies our lord, lord of the frenzied. The Three Fingers who holds us in thrall.

RW-ITEM-note-miquella-s-needle.text:
Note written by a nomadic merchant succinctly detailing knowledge acquired.

"The Empyrean Miquella crafted a needle to resist the influence of outer gods.

Those who have inherited the flame of frenzy, yet wish not to become its lord would do well to seek Miquella's Needle."

RW-ITEM-note-sealed-spiritsprings.text:
Note found by the forager brood, imparting knowledge in brief.

Should you chance upon a sealed spiritspring, look for stacked stones nearby. By toppling them, you may break the seal.

RW-ITEM-furnace-keeper-s-note.text:
A note left presumably by a furnace keeper, containing admonitions regarding the furnace's proper use.

Keep fire pots well clear when the golem's furnace is ablaze—and never let me catch you with pots that produce flaming whirlwinds, for goodness' sake.

RW-ITEM-torn-diary-page.text:
A discarded page ripped from a diary, bearing a passage written in a tremulous hand.

"I touched him, but only once.

When he thrust his staff in my face, I brushed it aside.

It was then that I touched him. The aging untouchable."

RW-ITEM-homing-instinct-painting.text:
Work of a wandering artist. Reminiscence of a painting titled "Homing Instinct."

This painter is said to have captured the landscapes seen during the last moments of those welcomed into death's embrace.

The soul of the painter, and vestiges of the dead's last moments can be discovered by visiting the location depicted even now.

ENC-A1-WL-0001.text: Grotesque creatures grafted with many limbs, with youthful faces and silver hair. They are enshrouded in green cloaks, and wield ornamental straightswords and shields.

ENC-A1-WL-0002.text: Soldiers who serve in the army of Godrick the Grafted. They are the remnants of the army that fled from the royal capital of the Erdtree. They wear orange-and-green surcoats bearing emblems of the Erdtree and the beast regent, an emblem of the Golden Lineage.

ENC-A1-WL-0003.text: An armored, cleaver-wielding Beastman found in the Groveside Cave in Limgrave. It is encountered in a wide cavern littered with dead Godrick Soldiers, who appear to have set up a camp before falling victim to the Beastman.

ENC-A1-WL-0004.text: Demi-Humans are typically small in stature and bestial in appearance, often possessing fur, canine faces, and pointed ears. Although they are intelligent and capable of speech, as exemplified by Boc the Seamster, they are typically violent and brutish, particularly at night when their blood boils and they turn feral.

ENC-A1-WL-0005.text: Trolls are descendants of the Giants, who betrayed their ancestors during the war against the Giants and fought on behalf of the Erdtree. They can be found throughout the Lands Between, often fighting on behalf of various armies and factions. They have broad torsos, with cavities in their chests exposing growths akin to roots or branches, which conceal stone stabs that were seemingly embedded into them. Sometimes, stakes are lodged into these cavities, allowing the trolls to drag carriages along behind them.

ENC-A1-WL-0006.text: An order of knights, dedicated to the protection of the Erdtree. They are considered to be the living rampart of the Erdtree, and served as inspiration for Leyndell's knights.

ENC-A1-EL-0002.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

ENC-A1-EL-0003.text: Knights in the service of Godrick the Grafted. They wear orange-and-green surcoats, with a plate on their left breast emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the Golden Lineage. Their helms are topped with plumes of ashen hair, reminiscent of that of their lord. The knights often carry greatshields coated in a red-tinged gold which mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree, said to be the color of homeward yearning.

ENC-A1-EL-0004.text: The Tibia Mariners were the first of all grave keepers in the Lands Between. They beckon Those Lost in Death by blowing into their hollow oars. They have guided the dead to the Gravesite Plain for an eternity, unbothered by their bones having long since crumbled to dust.

ENC-A1-WP-0010.text: Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are living statues resembling beasts with hunched bodies and long, cat-like tails. These golems are the protectors of catacombs where Erdtree burial took place, and are said to command the Imps.

ENC-A1-WP-0011.text: Demi-human queens tower over the average demi-humans. They possess long, lanky limbs and canine features, and wear crowns and tattered capes. The staves they wield, which are styled as sceptres, were given to the demi-humans to foster peace, but are sneered at by fools at the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

ENC-A1-WP-0012.text: Giant bears found throughout the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow. They are far larger than other Bears, and display strange markings on their chests.

ENC-A1-WP-0013.text: The Misbegotten are malformed beings that exhibit characteristics of different types of animals, often possessing tails, horns, scales, and wings. They are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and are often treated as slaves. They often wield large, iron weapons steeped in resentment.

ENC-A1-WP-0014.text: Beings with bodies resembling hollow tree stumps. The avatars emerged in the wake of the shattering of the Elden Ring in order to protect the Minor Erdtrees. They wield large staffs depicting the Erdtree, and are capable of utilising offensive incantations.

ENC-A1-WP-0015.text: A clan of knights who reside in the Mountaintops of the Giants, who earned renown during the war against the Fire Giants, their mortal enemies. They hail from the town of Zamor, and cloak themselves in icy tempests. They appear as tall, slender humanoids with long, silver hair and ornate masks. They are primarily found in the Zamor Ruins in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

ENC-A1-WP-0016.text: Shadowy, insect-ridden grave keepers found in catacombs. They are lanky, long-necked humanoids with hollow torsos and large, glowing eyes. Each has a creature resembling a spider or a crab sitting atop their head, and they fight with pairs of curved blades.

ENC-A1-WP-0017.text: Since antiquity, the carnivorous miranda flowers have been cultivated by the cloistered perfumers of Leyndell. Their potent, unspent pollen, extracted with great care, has long been a key ingredient in the creation of powerful healing aromatics.

ENC-A1-WP-0018.text: The Night's Cavalry are knights who ride atop funeral steeds and were once led by Margit, the Fell Omen, delivering death to great warriors, knights, and champions. Presently, they can be found across the Lands Between, appearing only at night, often carrying Ashes of War and equipment which can be looted upon their defeat.

ENC-A1-WP-0019.text: Deathbirds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body.

ENC-A1-WP-0020.text: Golems are giant stone guardians hailing from a civilization now gone to ruin. They are said to have been made by a golem crafter, using an impure crystal knife not unlike the Crystal Dart. Though typically wielding equally massive Golem's Halberd, some can be found carrying Golem Greatbows that they use with great precision.

ENC-A1-CM-0001.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

ENC-A1-CM-0002.text: The Misbegotten are malformed beings that exhibit characteristics of different types of animals, often possessing tails, horns, scales, and wings. They are held to be a punishment for making contact with the Crucible, and are often treated as slaves. They often wield large, iron weapons steeped in resentment.

ENC-A1-CM-0003.text: Crabs are commonly found around the coastlines, rivers, and lakes of the Lands Between. They vary in size, with the larger varieties being far more aggressive.

ENC-A1-CM-0004.text: Hulking Misbegotten with long, red manes and serpentine tails. Misbegotten Warriors typically fight using large, iron greatswords. As with other Misbegotten, their appearance is seen as a punishment for making contact with the Primordial Crucible.

ENC-A1-SH-0001.text: Elemer of the Briar, also known as the Bell Bearing Hunter, originally hailed from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics. He wears iron armor wrapped in iron thorns, which are a mark of the guilty and of those sentenced to death. He was slated for execution at the Shaded Castle, home of the family of House Marais, however he evaded death by snatching the sword from the site of his looming execution and furnished it with battle skills from his homeland. He gained the moniker "Bell Bearing Hunter" by killing numerous merchants and instructors, and taking their Bell Bearings.

ENC-A1-SH-0002.text: Golems are giant stone guardians hailing from a civilization now gone to ruin. They are said to have been made by a golem crafter, using an impure crystal knife not unlike the Crystal Dart. Though typically wielding equally massive Golem's Halberd, some can be found carrying Golem Greatbows that they use with great precision.

ENC-A1-SH-0003.text: A group of assassins who were responsible for the murder of Godwyn the Golden on the Night of Black Knives, using blades imbued with the power of death in a ritual performed by Ranni the Witch. They used Concealing Veils to hide their presence, rendering them effectively invisible.

ENC-A1-SH-0004.text: Knights in the service of Godrick the Grafted. They wear orange-and-green surcoats, with a plate on their left breast emblazoned with a two-headed war axe, an emblem of the Golden Lineage. Their helms are topped with plumes of ashen hair, reminiscent of that of their lord. The knights often carry greatshields coated in a red-tinged gold which mirrors the primordial matter that became the Erdtree, said to be the color of homeward yearning.

ENC-A1-SH-0005.text: A recusant in the service of Volcano Manor, Henricus will invade anyone who seeks out the Limgrave Colosseum.

ENC-A1-SH-0006.text: The Crucible Knights served Godfrey, the First Elden Lord. They were led by Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight Siluria, two honored as the foremost amongst the Crucible Knights. Their armor holds the power of the crucible of life. In time, their strength, even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

ENC-A1-SH-0007.text: Deathbirds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body.

ENC-A1-STV-0001.text: Margit is an Omen notorious for slaughtering countless champions who sought to become Elden Lord, and stacked their corpses high during the Second Defense of Leyndell.

ENC-A1-STV-0002.text: Knights who, whether by misfortune or misdeed, were forced to abandon their homes. Most were sent to the fringes, forced to start anew with only despair for company. Many of them wear helms adorned with sculptures of dragons, although some cover their helms with deep red scarves to protect themselves from the biting winds of the fringes.

ENC-A1-STV-0003.text: The Crucible Knights served Godfrey, the First Elden Lord. They were led by Crucible Knight Ordovis and Crucible Knight Siluria, two honored as the foremost amongst the Crucible Knights. Their armor holds the power of the crucible of life. In time, their strength, even their appearance, was seen as chaotic and deserving of scorn.

ENC-A1-STV-0004.text: Grotesque creatures grafted with many limbs, with youthful faces and silver hair. They are enshrouded in green cloaks, and wield ornamental straightswords and shields.

ENC-A1-STV-0005.text: Giant, serpentine entities with bark-like skin covered in red pustules, commonly found near the roots of the Erdtree. They use their claws and tails in combat, and can generate a burst of golden fire.

ENC-A1-STV-0006.text: Godrick is a descendant of the Golden Lineage, the bloodline which began with Queen Marika the Eternal and her first consort Godfrey. Only a distant relation of Marika's line, his divine blood was sorely diluted, and he was viewed as the runt of the litter.

ENC-A1-STV-0007.text: Elder Lions are powerful beasts found across the Lands Between. The lions have horns partially obscured by their manes, which are vestiges of the primordial Crucible.

ENC-A1-WL-0007.text: The Night's Cavalry are knights who ride atop funeral steeds and were once led by Margit, the Fell Omen, delivering death to great warriors, knights, and champions. Presently, they can be found across the Lands Between, appearing only at night, often carrying Ashes of War and equipment which can be looted upon their defeat.

ENC-A1-EL-0006.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

ENC-A1-EL-0007.text: Weaker descendants of the Ancient Dragons who once ruled the Lands Between. They did not inherit their ancestors' stone scales nor their command over lightning and so are vulnerable to it, and the very Gravelstone scales posessed by the ancient dragons can cause them mortal harm.

ENC-A1-EL-0008.text: Giant bears found throughout the Lands Between and Realm of Shadow. They are far larger than other Bears, and display strange markings on their chests.

ENC-A1-RTH-0001.text: Alberich was an aloof yet disturbed heretical sorcerer, his attire adorned by red glintstone born from the blood of sacrifices. It is said he was driven mad by jeering tongues during his service to the Roundtable Hold long ago.

ENC-A1-WL-0008.text: Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are living statues resembling beasts with hunched bodies and long, cat-like tails. These golems are the protectors of catacombs where Erdtree burial took place, and are said to command the Imps.

ENC-A1-WL-0009.text: A member of the Bloody Fingers, Nerijus is a Tarnished driven mad by bloodlust and in service to Mohg, Lord of Blood. He prowls along a shallow river in Limgrave, waiting to ambush Tarnished. When Nerijus attempts to ambush a Tarnished by invading them outside the cave, Yura, who knew him by name, came to the Tarnished's assistance.

ENC-A1-WL-0010.text: A Tarnished who leads a group of bandits, operating out of Murkwater Cave in Limgrave. Patches is a nomadic and free-spirited individual with a proclivity for tricking people and robbing them of their possessions.

ENC-A1-WL-0011.text: Former gladiators who were exiled from the colosseum. They wear bronze armor adorned with snakes, which are viewed as traitors to the Erdtree, and as such the audiences of their duels would delight in seeing them beaten and battered.

ENC-A1-WL-0012.text: A race of ancients with stone skin who are said to have risen to life when a meteor struck long ago. They wield swords made from blue-white meteoric ore, and utilise gravitational powers that pull things in.

ENC-A1-EL-0009.text: Bloodhound Knights are trained as hunters and are known to be unshakable trackers. Without the use of language, they choose their own master which they will stay loyal to for the rest of their life.

RW-BOSS-cleanrot-knight.text: A knight who vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the gradual and inevitable putrefaction of their flesh. They each carry a Winged Sword Insignia talisman, representing the beautiful and relentless blade of Malenia, in honor of their service to her. All Cleanrot Knights wield a Cleanrot Knight's Sword as a secondary weapon to complement their long-handed armaments. This allows them to land multiple attacks in quick succession, triggering the Talisman's blessing to strengthen them even further.

RW-BOSS-adan-thief-of-fire.text: A man dressed as a Fire Prelate, imprisoned in the Malefactor's Evergaol in south-western Liurnia of the Lakes. He once stole Flame of the Fell God, an incantation kept secret by Chief Guardian Arghanthy, which revealed that the fell god still lurks within the Flame of the Fire Giants.

RW-BOSS-omenkiller.text: Individuals tasked with hunting down and killing Omen. They wear masks with twisted horns carved to resemble the evil spirits seen by Omen in their nightmares, and wield paired cleavers affixed with severed Omen horns. They wear aprons that evoke the garb of Rollo, the first Omenkiller, a famous perfumer who imbibed a physick to rid himself of emotion in order to carry out the extermination of the Omen.

RW-BOSS-spiritcaller-snail.text: Pale, serpentine snails possessing the ability to summon spirits by emitting a ringing sound, akin to a Spirit Calling Bell. They possess limited offensive capabilities of their own, relying on their spirits to protect them. In some cases, they can teleport or turn themselves invisible.

RW-BOSS-royal-revenant.text: Pale, gaunt creatures resembling corpses with many limbs. They emerge from pools of shallow water, and attack with unnatural speed and the ability to inflict Poison.

Presently, they can be found across the Lands Between, appearing only at night, often carrying Ashes of War and equipment which can be looted upon their defeat.

RW-BOSS-crystalian.text: Mysterious, inorganic beings with crystalline bodies, who cleave close to the ideals of the Primeval Current and are regarded as guests by the sorcerers. They possess a form of cognition known as the "wisdom of the stone", and bear the sole purpose of safeguarding their crystals until the end. They wield weaponry fashioned from crystal, a deed impossible for a human, and are believed by some to await the return of their creator who will craft them new brethren. In combat, Crystalians are highly resistant to attacks.

RW-BOSS-glintstone-dragon-smarag.text: Weaker descendants of the Ancient Dragons who once ruled the Lands Between. They did not inherit their ancestors' stone scales nor their command over lightning and so are vulnerable to it, and the very Gravelstone scales posessed by the ancient dragons can cause them mortal harm.

RW-BOSS-crystalians-2x.text: Mysterious, inorganic beings with crystalline bodies, who cleave close to the ideals of the Primeval Current and are regarded as guests by the sorcerers. They possess a form of cognition known as the "wisdom of the stone", and bear the sole purpose of safeguarding their crystals until the end. They wield weaponry fashioned from crystal, a deed impossible for a human, and are believed by some to await the return of their creator who will craft them new brethren. In combat, Crystalians are highly resistant to attacks.

RW-BOSS-deathbird-2.text: Deathbirds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body.

RW-BOSS-death-rite-bird.text: Death Rite Birds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body, partially covered in ghostflame and guarded by the spirits of the servants of death inside their wings.

RW-BOSS-royal-knight-loretta.text: Loretta was once a royal Carian knight, and served as a personal guard for Carian royalty. Loretta's favored weapon was said to be the bow, and she developed sorceries imitating the power of a greatbow.

RW-BOSS-onyx-lord.text: The stone-skinned Onyx Lords belonged to a race of ancients that was granted life when a meteor struck the Lands Between long ago. In contrast to the Alabaster Lords, their gravitational-based glintstone sorceries focused on repulsion and the summoning of destructive Meteorites. They were worshiped and feared of their destructive power.

RW-BOSS-magma-wyrm-makar.text: Magma Wyrms are quadrupedal draconic beings with torn, vestigial wings and broad heads. They were once human heroes who partook in Dragon Communion, for which they were cursed to crawl the earth as flightless imitations of Dragons, losing their humanity in the process. They wield greatswords that resemble the jawbones of dragons, and can spew magma from their mouths.

RW-BOSS-red-wolf-of-radagon.text: Giant wolves with red fur adorned with jewellery. They are agile foes, capable of casting Glintblade sorceries. Some can manifest a golden sword, which they grip with their jaws in order to perform slashing attacks.

RW-BOSS-rennala-queen-of-the-full-moon.text: As a young astrologer who gazed at the night sky and always chased the stars, Rennala would encounter an enchanting full moon that would one day bewitch the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

RW-BOSS-dragonkin-soldier-of-nokstella.text: Dragon-like beings born in the Eternal City, they never knew true sky or true lightning, and so they wielded ice lightning as their weapon. They never achieved immortality, and perished as decrepit imitations of true Ancient Dragons.

RW-BOSS-dragonkin-soldier.text: Dragon-like beings born in the Eternal City, they never knew true sky or true lightning, and so they wielded ice lightning as their weapon. They never achieved immortality, and perished as decrepit imitations of true Ancient Dragons.

RW-BOSS-ancestor-spirit.text: Deer-like spirits found in Siofra River. They exist beyond the purview of the Erdtree, and follow the principle that life sprouts from death as it does from birth. This process is reflected by their horns, which sprout new growths even after the ancestor's death. Shamans of the Ancestral Followers don headdresses fashioned from horns with buds, mirroring the appearance of the ancestor spirits.

RW-BOSS-putrid-avatar.text: Beings with bodies resembling hollow tree stumps. The avatars emerged in the wake of the shattering of the Elden Ring in order to protect the Minor Erdtrees. They wield large staffs depicting the Erdtree, and are capable of utilising offensive incantations.

RW-BOSS-erdtree-burial-watchdogs-2x.text: Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are living statues resembling beasts with hunched bodies and long, cat-like tails. These golems are the protectors of catacombs where Erdtree burial took place, and are said to command the Imps.

RW-BOSS-mad-pumpkin-heads-2x.text: Gigantic humanoids with brawny physiques, known for their distinct oval helmets. They are former gladiators, broken and driven mad. Their helmets are pitch black inside, intended to keep the warriors from panicking, and to alleviate feelings of pressure and claustrophobia.

RW-BOSS-cleanrot-knights-2x.text: A knight who vowed to fight alongside Malenia, despite the gradual and inevitable putrefaction of their flesh. They each carry a Winged Sword Insignia talisman, representing the beautiful and relentless blade of Malenia, in honor of their service to her. All Cleanrot Knights wield a Cleanrot Knight's Sword as a secondary weapon to complement their long-handed armaments. This allows them to land multiple attacks in quick succession, triggering the Talisman's blessing to strengthen them even further.

RW-BOSS-magma-wyrm.text: Magma Wyrms are quadrupedal draconic beings with torn, vestigial wings and broad heads. They were once human heroes who partook in Dragon Communion, for which they were cursed to crawl the earth as flightless imitations of Dragons, losing their humanity in the process. They wield greatswords that resemble the jawbones of dragons, and can spew magma from their mouths.

RW-BOSS-frenzied-duelist.text: Former gladiators who were exiled from the colosseum. They wear bronze armor adorned with snakes, which are viewed as traitors to the Erdtree, and as such the audiences of their duels would delight in seeing them beaten and battered.

RW-BOSS-decaying-ekzykes.text: Weaker descendants of the Ancient Dragons who once ruled the Lands Between. They did not inherit their ancestors' stone scales nor their command over lightning and so are vulnerable to it, and the very Gravelstone scales posessed by the ancient dragons can cause them mortal harm.

RW-BOSS-night-s-cavalry-2.text: The Night's Cavalry are knights who ride atop funeral steeds and were once led by Margit, the Fell Omen, delivering death to great warriors, knights, and champions. Presently, they can be found across the Lands Between, appearing only at night, often carrying Ashes of War and equipment which can be looted upon their defeat.

RW-BOSS-death-rite-bird-2.text: Death Rite Birds are gigantic decaying birds with incrusted corpses over their body, partially covered in ghostflame and guarded by the spirits of the servants of death inside their wings.

RW-BOSS-cemetery-shade-2.text: Shadowy, insect-ridden grave keepers found in catacombs. They are lanky, long-necked humanoids with hollow torsos and large, glowing eyes. Each has a creature resembling a spider or a crab sitting atop their head, and they fight with pairs of curved blades.

RW-BOSS-commander-o-neil.text: A veteran of a battle that took place in the Swamp of Aeonia in Caelid. He continued to brandish his flag in the rot-eaten battlefield even after his lord fled. He wears the same armor and wields the same standard as Commander Niall, the leader of an army of no nation situated in Castle Sol.

RW-BOSS-fallingstar-beast.text: Fallingstar Beasts are creatures formed of shiny black rock. They have spiky tails, patches of white fur, and insect-like mandibles. They are found in craters, likely indicating that they plummeted onto the Lands Between from a great distance.

RW-BOSS-nox-swordstress-and-nox-monk.text: The Nox are the inhabitants of the Eternal Cities of Nokron and Nokstella. They are a grey-skinned, cold-blooded race known for wielding flowing weapons forged from the liquid metal of Silver Tears.

RW-BOSS-putrid-crystalians-3x.text: Mysterious, inorganic beings with crystalline bodies, who cleave close to the ideals of the Primeval Current and are regarded as guests by the sorcerers. They possess a form of cognition known as the "wisdom of the stone", and bear the sole purpose of safeguarding their crystals until the end. They wield weaponry fashioned from crystal, a deed impossible for a human, and are believed by some to await the return of their creator who will craft them new brethren. In combat, Crystalians are highly resistant to attacks.

RW-BOSS-battlemage-hugues.text: Scholars of the Haima Conspectus of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Haima scholars are the adjudicators of the Academy, who studied sorceries of cannon and gavel in order to gain the power to quell conflict. Whenever war broke out and the Academy sealed its gates, the battlemages of Haima were the only scholars who dared venture outside. As such, they can be found in many regions of the Lands Between. The stone clubs they carry reflect their more forceful approach, allowing them to feel the impact of their blows so they do not lose sight of the true essence of battle.

RW-BOSS-misbegotten-warrior-and-crucible.text: Hulking Misbegotten with long, red manes and serpentine tails. Misbegotten Warriors typically fight using large, iron greatswords. As with other Misbegotten, their appearance is seen as a punishment for making contact with the Primordial Crucible.

RW-BOSS-starscourge-radahn.text: Radahn was the son of Queen Rennala and Radagon, and became a demigod stepchild after his father's marriage to Queen Marika. He is regarded as the mightiest hero of the demigods, and was feared as the strongest demigod of the Shattering.

RW-BOSS-mimic-tear.text: Formless creatures of mimicry found in and around the Eternal Cities. They make a mockery of life, reborn again and again into imitation. They are viscous, silver droplets, and they can manifest spear-like appendages from their bodies. Some can generate electricity, while others sport hardened shields that protect them from damage.

RW-BOSS-regal-ancestor-spirit.text: Deer-like spirits found in Siofra River. They exist beyond the purview of the Erdtree, and follow the principle that life sprouts from death as it does from birth. This process is reflected by their horns, which sprout new growths even after the ancestor's death. Shamans of the Ancestral Followers don headdresses fashioned from horns with buds, mirroring the appearance of the ancestor spirits.

RW-BOSS-valiant-gargoyles.text: A colossal winged guardian, mended with corpse wax, patchwork of champions. They all fight with two weapons, one for quick, close-ranged combat and the other for slower, but more far-reaching, engagements. Some of their attacks are enhanced by techniques similar to the Storm Arts of Stormveil. Like themselves, the weapons have also been mended with corpse wax. Despite showing great discipline with their arsenal, they will use the Beast's Roar to destroy those who would run away from them.

RW-BOSS-crucible-knight-siluria.text: Siluria was a member of the Crucible Knights who served Lord Godfrey. She was one of the order's two most-renowned Crucible Knights, and her men bore her mark of the great tree ornamentation.

RW-BOSS-fia-s-champions.text: Upon arriving to the Prince of Dead's throne at Deeproot Depths, a Fia's Champion will invade the player. When defeated, a spectre of Sorcerer Rogier is summoned. Once he is felled two more "Fia's Champions" spawn, together with Lionel the Lionhearted.

RW-BOSS-lichdragon-fortissax.text: Fortissax is an Ancient Dragon who was once known as the "mightiest boulderstone", known for its use of twin red lightning stakes, and the sibling of Ancient Dragon Lansseax.

RW-BOSS-dragonkin-soldier-2.text: Dragon-like beings born in the Eternal City, they never knew true sky or true lightning, and so they wielded ice lightning as their weapon. They never achieved immortality, and perished as decrepit imitations of true Ancient Dragons.

RW-BOSS-astel-naturalborn-of-the-void.text: A malformed star born in a flightless void far away, composed of many-colored star debris. It is said to have assailed an Eternal City, destroying it and taking away its sky.

RW-BOSS-glintstone-dragon-adula.text: Weaker descendants of the Ancient Dragons who once ruled the Lands Between. They did not inherit their ancestors' stone scales nor their command over lightning and so are vulnerable to it, and the very Gravelstone scales posessed by the ancient dragons can cause them mortal harm.

RW-BOSS-alecto-black-knife-ringleader.text: A group of assassins who were responsible for the murder of Godwyn the Golden on the Night of Black Knives, using blades imbued with the power of death in a ritual performed by Ranni the Witch. They used Concealing Veils to hide their presence, rendering them effectively invisible.

RW-BOSS-perfumer-tricia-and-misbegotten-.text: Perfumers of Leyndell were once respected as blessed apothecaries, and they wore aprons embroidered with depictions of the Erdtree as symbols of their pride and responsibility. However, during the Shattering they became active combatants, using their apothecarial skills to produce poisons and elixirs. The art of perfuming, once jealously guarded within the capital, became widespread as the war raged on.

RW-BOSS-necromancer-garris.text: Garris was heretical sage who rediscovered an ancient death hex capable of summoning vengeful spirits. He wields a chain weapon consisting of three copper heads said to resemble his wife and two children, whose tormented spirits it can call forth.

RW-BOSS-black-knife-assassin-3.text: A group of assassins who were responsible for the murder of Godwyn the Golden on the Night of Black Knives, using blades imbued with the power of death in a ritual performed by Ranni the Witch. They used Concealing Veils to hide their presence, rendering them effectively invisible.

RW-BOSS-demi-human-queen-gilika.text: A Demi-Human Queen found in a cellar in the Lux Ruins of Altus Plateau, guarding a chest that contains a Ritual Sword Talisman.

RW-BOSS-godefroy-the-grafted.text: A member of the Golden Lineage, he is a descendant of Godfrey, First Elden Lord, and Queen Marika the Eternal. Much like his kinsman Godrick the Grafted, Godefroy has practised the grotesque act of grafting. He was involved in the first siege on Leyndell, Royal Capital, but was defeated and captured by Kristoff, the Ancient Dragon Knight, after which he was imprisoned in an Evergaol.

RW-BOSS-tibia-mariner-2.text: The Tibia Mariners were the first of all grave keepers in the Lands Between. They beckon Those Lost in Death by blowing into their hollow oars. They have guided the dead to the Gravesite Plain for an eternity, unbothered by their bones having long since crumbled to dust.

RW-BOSS-erdtree-burial-watchdog-3.text: Erdtree Burial Watchdogs are living statues resembling beasts with hunched bodies and long, cat-like tails. These golems are the protectors of catacombs where Erdtree burial took place, and are said to command the Imps.

RW-BOSS-stonedigger-troll.text: Trolls are descendants of the Giants, who betrayed their ancestors during the war against the Giants and fought on behalf of the Erdtree. They can be found throughout the Lands Between, often fighting on behalf of various armies and factions. They have broad torsos, with cavities in their chests exposing growths akin to roots or branches, which conceal stone stabs that were seemingly embedded into them. Sometimes, stakes are lodged into these cavities, allowing the trolls to drag carriages along behind them.

RW-BOSS-elemer-of-the-briar.text: Elemer of the Briar, also known as the Bell Bearing Hunter, originally hailed from Eochaid, a land of proudly solitary ascetics. He wears iron armor wrapped in iron thorns, which are a mark of the guilty and of those sentenced to death. He was slated for execution at the Shaded Castle, home of the family of House Marais, however he evaded death by snatching the sword from the site of his looming execution and furnished it with battle skills from his homeland. He gained the moniker "Bell Bearing Hunter" by killing numerous merchants and instructors, and taking their Bell Bearings.

RW-BOSS-night-s-cavalry-3.text: The Night's Cavalry are knights who ride atop funeral steeds and were once led by Margit, the Fell Omen, delivering death to great warriors, knights, and champions. Presently, they can be found across the Lands Between, appearing only at night, often carrying Ashes of War and equipment which can be looted upon their defeat.

RW-BOSS-fallingstar-beast-2.text: Fallingstar Beasts are creatures formed of shiny black rock. They have spiky tails, patches of white fur, and insect-like mandibles. They are found in craters, likely indicating that they plummeted onto the Lands Between from a great distance.

RW-BOSS-omenkiller-and-miranda-the-bligh.text: Miranda the Blighted Bloom was a poisonous, man-eating miranda blossom with the ability to summon a downpour of holy light. This toxic breed of flowers was said to have been an aspect of the Crucible in an age long past. The powdery, fragrant pollen produced by Miranda and her offspring was harvested by perfumers for use in their aromatics since antiquity. Miranda took root within the Perfumer's Grotto and was later infected with a festering blight. Her affliction spread to the other flowers grown in the cave.

RW-BOSS-wormface.text: Towering, emaciated creatures with worm-like tentacles protruding from their faces. They regularly cough up clouds of Death Blight which cover a large area around them. The majority of them reside in the woodlands of the Altus Plateau, however there are also several of them residing in Crumbling Farum Azula.

RW-BOSS-crystalians-2x-2.text: Mysterious, inorganic beings with crystalline bodies, who cleave close to the ideals of the Primeval Current and are regarded as guests by the sorcerers. They possess a form of cognition known as the "wisdom of the stone", and bear the sole purpose of safeguarding their crystals until the end. They wield weaponry fashioned from crystal, a deed impossible for a human, and are believed by some to await the return of their creator who will craft them new brethren. In combat, Crystalians are highly resistant to attacks.

RW-BOSS-godskin-apostle.text: Lanky humanoids clad in robes sewn together from patches of smooth skin. The Godskin Apostles were led by the Gloam-Eyed Queen, who cradled them as newborns in a swaddling cloth made from skin much like their robes. They served Destined Death, and wielded god-slaying black flame. However, when Maliketh, the Black Blade, sealed away the Rune of Death, the flame's true power was lost.

RW-BOSS-ancient-dragon-lansseax.text: Ancient Dragons have light grey bodies resembling stone. They possess four legs, as well as four wings inlayed with gold, distinguishing them from their lesser descendants. They have short, flat muzzles, orange-yellow eyes, and wispy grey hairs along their backs.
